title: V perine
description:
The great musical comedy by F. A. Brabec V perine is the first Czech film made entirely in 3D. This stimulating comedy, in true and thorough 3D, presents a whole new computer-made world concealed in a quilt, where a large part of the film is taking place.

The film V perine is a musical comedy made in the high-spirited style of Mamma Mia. In a relaxed world, where everybody used to dance rock'n'roll and the streets were full of pink Cadillacs, good and bad dreams hidden in our quilts take form. The musical adventure culminates in the magical world of dreams.

Twenty two original songs accompany you throughout V perine. The films score and most songs were composed by René Rypar from the band Support Lesbiens, several exceptional guests contributed with their music. Two pieces were composed especially for the film by the band Kabát, and a melody written exclusively for In The Quilt by Karel Svoboda will be heard, several years after his death. The lyrics were put together by Writer Miroslav Adamec and Frantisek Moravec.

The casting is quite grandiose: the bold and possibly slightly goofy Lucie Bila sings and dances seemingly at fingers reach, and youll experience Karel Roden as never seen before. The strong cast further includes Jirí Mádl, Anna Stropnická, Eliska Balzerová, newly holder of a Czech Lion award, Bolek Polívka, Nikol Moravcová, Arnost Goldflam, Nina Divísková. The children Amelie Pokorná and Matej Prevrátil complete the cast.

The film V perine, which will surely get you in the right summertime mood, was shot in the city od Písek, in the South of Bohemia.

description: What happens when a homophobic father reappears in his son's life after 20 years of estrangement?

title: The Jester's Plane: A Curious Journey Down the Rabbithole
description: 5 years after the actual tragic events, the Jester embarks on a curious journey down a mysterious rabbithole. A comedic conspiracy about the necessity of critical thinking.

title: Entre vivir y soñar
description: When Ana married Felix, the leader of a rock band and son of a travel agent, she thought her life would be plenty of excitement and travels. Now, in her forties, she leads a monotonous life with her husband and her daughter, giving cooking lessons and taking French courses. But one day she receives an invitation to give a cooking course in Paris.

title: Cinco vidas y un destino
description:
Five fellons are running from justice in search of freedom. During their escape, they run into María Flores who joins them on their journey. They will do what it takes to cross the border and escape a search party that is on their persuit.

The hero, Marcos Navarro, who is part of the five fellons is actually innocent. He was framed by his former employer with charges of murder and theft because he was having an affair with the landlord's daughter. 

He escapes his captors and joins other men as they attempt to cross borders. Running thorugh the mountains is their only choice as they have a warrant for their inmediate arrest.

title: María y los niños pobres
description: Due to different circumstances several kids work in the streets of La Paz (Bolivia). While a group of Catholic priests help them they are endangered by organ thieves and drug dealers. When one of the children is kidnapped and the perpetrators evade the Bolivian police the Blessed Virgen Mary intervenes unfolding miraculous events.

title: La Doctora y el Centavo
description: La hija que su familia desterró hace diez años regresa a la boda de su hermana, y todos se burlan de ella: «una fracasada sin dinero». Hasta que el patriarca de los Navarro se inclina ante ella: «Doctora Castillo». La humillada resulta ser la profesora titular más joven de una universidad de élite y el genio del que depende el futuro de toda la familia. ¿Perdonará a quienes la despreciaron?

title: [doblado] Entre celos y desamor
description: Laura Rivas amó durante años a Pablo Gómez, sin saber que su afecto no era más que una estrategia para acercarla a Sergio Lima, heredero de la Mansión del Duque, y así sabotear el compromiso con Eva Santos. Al descubrir que solo fue un instrumento para provocar los celos de Eva, Laura, herida, llevó su engaño con Sergio hasta el matrimonio, mientras Pablo quedaba consumido por el arrepentimiento.

title: El niño y la niebla
description: Marta (Dolores del Río) es una mujer que vive obsesionada, ya que su madre y su hermano murieron de esquizofrenia. Temerosa de que la enfermedad sea congénita, sobreprotege hasta el extremo a su único hijo (Alejandro Ciangherotti Jr.). Debido a su obsesión, Marta no se da cuenta que la única afectada psicológicamente en su familia es ella.

title: El alcalde y la política
description: The current mayor of a small but strategic town decides to run again . His style is quite dictatorial and allows gambling and prostitution . The political party will only support him only if it pursues such activities.

description: Pipp Petals creates a music festival, Bridlewoodstock getting bands from around to Equestria to perform at the Bridlewood venue. But the unicorns are terrified of the performance, fearsome of the tale of the voice eating troggles.

title: A Wife for a Wife
description: Far from home, with nothing to worry about but the socks he'll wear, Chad is letting it loose, regardless of his wife's short rope. The first beauty he sees is in for a wild afternoon with is massive cock, when she saunters into his life to sunbathe by the pool. When Derrick picks up the phone, he never expected to hear Xander's voice again, but when Xander explains that he needs a little help, Derrick, his old friend can't help but submit to his good friend's cause. Xander needs to make bail so he can make it to his wedding to Jessa. Apparently things got a little wild at his bachelor party and he just wanted to make the best of his last night as a free man. Reena, Derrick's wife, isn't having any of this guy's foolishness, but when Xander shows up, things take a turn that no one would expect. Even Ryan gets a dose of his own medicine when he discovers that hook up arranged is secretly his wife.

Why these murders and who is the culprit how to nab this horrific killer?

title: An American Ascent
description: An American Ascent documents the first African American expedition to tackle Denali, North America's highest peak and explores the complex relationship many African-Americans have with the outdoors. As the United States transitions to a 'minority majority' nation, a staggering number of people of color do not identify with America's wild places. By embarking on the grueling multi-week climb of the 20,327ft Denali, nine African-American climbers set out to bridge this 'adventure gap' - challenging outdated notions of what adventure looks like by changing the face of America's biggest and baddest mountain on the 100th anniversary of its first summit.

title: An Orphan's Dream
description: This is the incredible story of two orphans who were given a chance to dream... Durga, born in an impoverished village in Nepal, was orphaned at 10 years old - becoming Mom and Dad to her younger brother. She sent him to school while she worked at a gravel pit - chipping rocks. After being rescued by a Canadian NGO, Durga was given her first chance to go to school. Today she is 20 years old and graduating as a certified accountant. She is introduced to photographer Samantha Walker, who documents her life in photography - expressing the pain of the past to the hope of the present and future. After losing his family in the rebel wars in Liberia, Africa, Philip struggled through a series of UNBELIEVABLE events. Yet he seized opportunities that led him to become a top student at the University of Johannesburg. His encounter with singer-songwriter Andrew Smith is filled with emotion. Smith will write an instrumental song about Philip's experiences - while they journey back into his childhood of terror.

title: Funeral for an Assassin
description: A professional assassin has a vendetta against his former employer for their betrayal and his subsequent imprisonment.

title: Bait for an Adolescent
description: Maribel, a young typist, goes to work in a construction company as secretary of the director, Don Ignacio. To seduce the girl, he gets a loan so that the parents can buy a new home and that way he gets Maribel to accompany him to London. They start an affair in London. Upon their return to Madrid, both continue their relationship until Carlos appears, a young journalist whom she knows when he interviews the builder. title: Sockless: An Einstein Project
description: A man and his younger sister encounter physicist Albert Einstein.

title: Jesus: An Untold Story
description: Young Jesus travels to India, to find his true way.

title: Copley: An American Fairytale
description: Copley: An American Fairytale

title: Death in an Afternoon
description: A mad capped afternoon of death and love and betrayal as strangers are brought together to understand the death of their friend and colleague and question their own mortality's.

title: Gone in an Instant
description: A documentary that chronicles the rise and fall of NBA superstar Antoine Walker's fame and fortune. Antoine Walker's story speaks for itself. Amassing over $110 million during a 13-year NBA career, Walker went from being an NBA All-Star and World Champion to facing felony charges stemming from gambling debt in Las Vegas. However, vice was not his sole enemy; his generosity to more than 70 family members and friends evenly contributed to the drain of his fortune. Now successfully navigating bankruptcy, Antoine is on a mission to educate others on financial literacy, using his own story as a warning and an effective platform for others to learn from his mistakes. The documentary is the first of many planned projects by "It's The Comeback Kids LLC" that will feature individuals working to better the lives of others through charity.

title: Bloodsworth: An Innocent Man
description: Charged. Convicted. Sentenced to Death. Innocent. Follows the 1st death row inmate exonerated by DNA in the US.

title: Katherine of Sinai
description: Constantine joins the Roman army to find his missing childhood friend. Once alerted to his friend's whereabouts, he prepares for an all out war between the East and the West.

title: Althusser, an Intellectual Adventure
description: Philosopher, Marxist, professor, murderer. More than a quarter century after his death, Louis Althusser, one of the most influential leftist thinkers of the 20th century, remains an enigmatic figure.

title: Theremin: An Electronic Odyssey
description: A documentary about the inventor of the first electronic synthesiser instrument and his subsequent life after he was abducted by the KGB as well as a history of his instrument.

title: Mundo ao Contrário
description: A story about family, and about how the love between siblings, parents and children can stand up to anything, even death or ruin. It's a story of crime and mystery, of moral sin and terrible vengeance. Of the battle between good and evil, which rages every day on street corners and in living rooms, among the rich and among the poor. It is a story of a learning process, and how to overcome difficulties. Of how Constança, Catarina and Joao will try, together, and each in their own way, to defeat evil and restore their world to its rightful place...

title: Sobrevivi ao Holocausto
description: Julio Gartner was 15 years old when Germany invaded Poland on the Second World War. He lived in Krakow, Poland with his parents and brothers. Now Julio is 88 years old, and takes us back to Poland, Austria, Italy, France, Brazil, and tells us his survival story. Ghettos, concentration camps, villages. With a perfect memory for details, Julio brings a lot of emotion to his narrative.

title: Ao Fim da Noite

But the owner of the nightclub, Queirós, is also involved in another less lawful but more profitable business: the diamond trade. Queirós is a cold and sophisticated man whose only weakness is an obsessive passion for a woman who has already betrayed him.

title: Ao-chan Can't Study! [English]

title: A Year at Sherbrooke
description: Photographer Thelma Pepper and painter Jeff Nachtigall believe that creativity is essential for being fully alive. A Year At Sherbrooke follows these two artists as they work with the residents of Sherbrooke Community Centre, a Canadian facility that is gaining international recognition for its innovations in long-term care. title: Three Days at Foster
description: In the 1950s and '60s, the epic battle to end institutional racism reverberated across the South. Many of the pivotal mileposts in the civil rights movement happened in Alabama, where segregation's hold was especially severe and unforgiving. One event came to symbolize Southern resistance: Segregationist Governor George Wallace's stand 'in the schoolhouse door' at the University of Alabama on June 11, 1963. Using Foster Auditorium, the site of Wallace's stand, as a symbol of change across five decades, THREE DAYS AT FOSTER focuses on the pioneer athletes who subsequently shattered the color barrier at the University of Alabama, in the shadow of Wallace's infamous stand...and how these civil rights pioneers tapped into a force more powerful than hate. Featuring Danny Treadwell, who integrated the state basketball tournament at Foster Auditorium, just 33 months after Wallace's stand; Dock Rone, Andrew Pernell and Arthur Dunning, who walked on to the all-white Alabama football team in 1967 but have largely been lost to history; Wendell Hudson, UA's first African-American scholarship athlete; and Wilbur Jackson, the first black man signed by Paul "Bear" Bryant's football program. Intimate and revealing, it is a story about personal struggle and triumph, and ultimately, about the power of sports to touch hearts, change minds and heal a state's wounds.

title: Make Yourself at Home

title: Generation Ax
description: Two giggly high school lovebirds playfully throw pieces of bloody human brain at one another, then take a messy shower, in the latest horror flick out of South Carolina, which is fast becoming the Gruesome Gus capital of the world. The flick is called GENERATION AX, and it's HEATHERS meets SCREAM meets THE TEXAS CHEERLEADER MOM meets BONNIE AND CLYDE. Tommy Faircloth wrote and directed this little low-budget gem starring Marina Morgan as the high school girl whose best friend wants to be a cheerleader, so she sort of helps her out with a locker-room hatchet job on the beauty-pageant queen who beat her friend in tryouts. Pretty soon Marina falls for the new kid intown, Brian Kelly, because he believes that everyone dies because of "fate," so if you kill somebody, they would have died anyway. They soon get a chance to try out this cosmological theory ...[on a classmate]. Faircloth keeps this baby moving with plenty of nasty humor and humorous nastiness, although the death scenes can be a little lame, mostly because Marina holds her little hatchet like such a girl. (You know how girls throw a baseball? Same deal.) Between the time the picture was made and the time it was released, Columbine happened, which just might have hurt distribution a little bit. It's no longer cool to make funny films about geeky high school misfits killing the jocks and cheerleaders. To which I say: Thank God for South Carolina. Nine dead bodies. Two breasts. Chest-gutting. Multiple cheerleader-hatcheting. Tongue-nailing. Brain-hacking. Body of a "skeezer" deposited in the popcorn machine. Stiletto pom-pom to the face. Head rolls. Gratuitous water-bong.

title: He Died Unwanted, Came Back Rich
description: Framed and exiled, an adopted son returns to face a family that neglected him for years. Despite a severe heart condition, he rises to become a billionaire CEO, demanding a "family severance agreement." But a shocking truth about his birth and a vengeful biological mother unravels, while his adopted brother's betrayal escalates into a dangerous corporate war, leaving him to fight for justice and find his true family amidst lingering threats.

title: Caché Derrière Les Roses ( Doublé )
description: Pour jauger sa fiancée Zoé, le milliardaire Maël se glisse à la fac en se faisant passer pour un étudiant défavorisé. Zoé le désigne comme cobaye d'un jeu. Elle simule une cour assidue, ayant parié avec ses complices qu'elle l'abandonnerait en un mois. Maël entre dans la danse tout en contrôlant chaque mouvement en coulisses, et ceux qui se croyaient prédateurs deviennent des proies. Il transforme la chasse en condamnation publique retentissante de la jeunesse dorée.

title: Be Passionately in Love
description: Zhi Xu, a top student, meets Luzhou Chen, a troublemaker with a violent past, during the summer after her college entrance exam. Despite their contrasting reputations, an unexpected connection forms between them.

title: Kyle D
description: Bar owner, ex-con and street entrepreneur Kyle 'D' Polizzi does his level best to stay out of prison---despite breaking all the rules.

title: Saluti e baci
description: Carlo Mastelli, the young radio presenter of "New Voices" has run short of ideas and his program is likely to be suspended from the radio schedule if he does not find any new ones. He is saved by chance in the person of Marina, a charming young school teacher, who takes advantage of the presence of a radio crew in her village for the recording of a singing contest to broadcast an appeal in favor of Tonino, the most underprivileged of her pupils. She asks the listeners to send postcards from any place in the world to cheer up little Tonino. The response is enthusiastic and tons of mail land in the radio studios, at the same time boosting the audience of Calo's moribund program. Eventually, despite some trouble with a rare stamp, all ends well and Carlo marries Marina.

title: Kalluri Saalai
description: The series revolves around a guy and his friends - a gang of five, who take up a promise that they would never associate with girls throughout their lifetime. Does he keep up the promise to his friends or pursues his love?

title: L'infiltrée
description: L'infiltrée

title: The Ideal Soul
description: Elsa, 40 and single, has abandoned hope for love. Her unusual gift of seeing and speaking to the dead isolates her from others. Then she meets Oscar, a charming man who reignites her belief in possibilities.

title: Mon mari m’a détruite, je suis revenue plus forte que jamais
description: Léa Moretti a passé dix ans à aimer un homme qui ne voyait plus sa valeur. Après une trahison qui détruit son mariage et bouleverse sa vie, elle décide de ne plus être la femme qui pardonne toujours. Entre douleur, renaissance et succès, Léa construit un nouvel avenir et devient une icône du tatouage. Quand son ancien amour revient après des années de regrets, il découvre une femme qu’il ne peut plus contrôler. Peut-il vraiment récupérer celle qu’il a perdue ?

title: Tom Arnold: That's My Story and I'm Sticking to it
description: LOL Comedy presents Tom Arnold's first one-hour stand-up comedy special. From Iowa to L.A., Tom's hilarious real life journey is well documented in American pop cultural history. Tom exposes himself, his four marriages, his well publicized marriage to Rosanne Barr and all they went through and his lifelong friendships developed while working on 72 films. Tom Arnold was filmed in front of a sold out audience at San Bernardino's 1,700 seat Historic California Theatre of the Performing Arts for Showtime.

title: O Quarto
description: An ordinary forty-year old man living alone in a small, drab apartment faces the imminent loss of both his job and his eyesight. An unexpected affair with a beautiful, idle and bored socialite becomes his last hope.

title: O Debate
description: A chief editor of a newsroom and a TV host, who were married for a long time, must try to conciliate their personal distinct views while working together during the coverage of a political debate of great importance for the nation's future.

title: Deen-O
description: When a few local kids discover a dormant military operation, magic comes alive and the adventure unfolds as they learn about and defend their new friend Deen-O

title: O prigipas
description: A farmer decides to stage his death in order to avoid paying his unfair debts and scare some people into doing the right thing. When he is seen alive by his fellow villagers they think it is a miracle which the military government of the time tries to take advantage of.

title: O Príncipe
description: After 20 years of exile in Paris, Gustavo returns to his native city São Paulo. Back home, he encounters a place which no longer exists. His old friends and family members have changed, almost beyond recognition. He tries to recapture the past, and make some sense of his life, that of his friends and family, and the present state of his native country.

title: Desejada por Dois: o Vampiro e o Caçador
description:
Sou um desastre. Derrubei café no meu chefe gato, o Simon. Logo depois, descubri que tenho um poder secreto que não consigo controlar.
Meu mundo virou uma bagunça de café derramado e sentimentos confusos, e agora estou presa entre dois homens incríveis.
De um lado, o Simon, meu chefe misterioso, tão sedutor quanto perigoso — um vampiro que prometeu me ensinar a dominar minha magia.
Do outro, o Michael, meu melhor amigo, gentil e leal... Mas ele esconde um segredo terrível: é um caçador jurado a destruir tudo o que Simon representa.
Os dois me querem. E quanto mais forte fica a minha magia, mais intensa se torna a chama entre nós. Como vou escolher, se os dois conhecem meus segredos mais sombrios?

title: Crack o' Dawn
description: The Thompson-Thorpe automobile was once a great car but the failure of the owners to be able to agree on needed changes led to the break-up of the company, and Thompson and Thorpe has each started their own car-manufacturing company. Not knowing his true identity, Earle Thorpe Jr. has been hired by Henry Thompson to drive his new car in an upcoming race. Thompson has two crooked mechanic/engineers who plan to make their own car, using Thompson's plans, and win the big race themselves. Thompson's daughter, Ette, and Earle become close and resolve to settle the feud and re-unite Thompson and Thorpe Sr. They take the best features of both cars and combine them into one super car. But, Stanley Steele, the Thompson mechanic steals the car.

title: Jack 'O' Slasher
description: A demon from Hell has an insatiable lust for blood. He is sent from hell to help a Satanic cult try to resurrect Satan and bring eternal Hell on Earth.

title: Quebrando o Tabu
description: Inspired by the documentary feature film and the "Quebrando o Tabu" digital channel, the 10 episode docuseries debates several challenging themes: prostitution, gun control, privatization, abortion, inequality, among others. Each episode explores and debates a different controversial topic.

title: O Ja Sope

Find out more in this educating movie featuring Bolanle Ninalowo, Kemi Korede, Dotun Emmanuel, Kunle Adegbite, Funke Etti, Jumoke George, Rukayat Lawal, Dele Michael and a host of others.

title: Raine SHOOKT sa naging kapalaran sa Miss Q&A
description:
May mensahe ka ba sa ex mong biglang nag-walkout sa buhay mo? Kung may gustong o-shoutout, aba’y huwag nang mahiya. Katulad ng "It's Showtime" hosts na matapang na humugot tungkol sa kanilang mga TOTGA, at mga ex na minsan silang pinaluha.

Kung si Brent Manalo ay may shoutout sa "dating Big Winner" ng buhay niya, si Ryan Bang naman ay may mensahe sa babaeng naghatid ng pag-ibig na hindi natuloy sa dambana. At si Kim Chiu, hindi raw pinagsisihan si ex pero hindi na niya ito babalikan dahil may mga bagay na dapat ala-ala na lang.

Walang awat din sa pagtalak ang mga Miss Q and A Talaki-Talks of the week na sina Xantie, Raine Garcia, Stacey Doroteo, Adam Lambert, at Dhey Pascual Abital.

Effective ang reminder ni Vice Ganda sa mga accla na maging mas maliksi at witty. Bawal dito ang mababa ang energy. Kaya sunod-sunod ang kanilang pagsagot sa Tumpak Ganern round hanggang si Stacey ang naiwan at dumiretso na sa uwian. Samantala, ang apat ay naglaban-laban sa Wit Lang kung saan umangat sina Raine at Xantie.

Ang Beklamation question of the day, "Kung ikaw ang original jowa, anong gagawin mo sa keridang mas matapang pa umasta kaysa sa'yo?"

Pleasant ang energy kaya pleasant din ang pagpasok ng swerte para sa mga taga-Pleasant Hills, Mandaluyong City na na humataw ay nag-enjoy sa Laro Laro Pick.

Sa moves niyang bigay-todo, kuhang-kuha ni Nanay Inday ang atensyon mo. Ang kuwentuhan, kung saan na napunta. How true na 'nepo mommy' si Inday at low-key rich siya? Tahimik lang din sa 'gedli' si player Badjong pero kapag tinitigan, ay, pang leading man!

Looking for pleasant personality? Meron n'yan si Chel, ang masipag na manikurista na very happy sa love life with her lesbian partner, Shella. Dahil inspired, may extra tapang si Chel na sugalan ang POT question na katumbas na ng P350,000.

Bigo si Chel na maibigay ang tamang sagot. Pero, sabi nga ni Vice Ganda, mahal na mahal niya ang mga kapwa niya members ng LGBT community. Gusto niyang pasayahin sina Chel at Shella, kaya may regalo siyang P20,000 sa couple.

title: Holky z fildy
description: Revolution Girls is the story of four Czech women of the '89 generation. Philosophy students in Prague in 1989, all took active part in a dramatic historic event, the Velvet Revolution, which brought down the Communist regime. The film explores the legacy of the revolution upon their lives almost twenty years later. Jana Hybaskova, a member of the European Parliament, keeps trying to save the world. Alena Jezkova writes one book after another, probing the past for inspiration that the free but confusing present doesn't offer. Alice Rahmanova, a successful if reluctant businesswoman, is channeling most of her energies into raising her three children, including an adopted daughter. Pavla Milcova; has totally devoted her life to music and spiritual quests. What's left of their revolutionary ideals? How many revolutions must a woman go through before she reaches forty? And what can their stories tell us about the time and place they live in?

title: Kattbreven
description: 13-year-old Sofi moves involuntary from the big city to the countryside with her mother, and her mother's boyfriend while all her friends is back in the city. At the new place Sofi meet up with a wise old lady, that tells her scary stories about unsolved mysteries from the village past.

title: Love and Lemons
description: This is a romantic comedy about love, friendship and the courage it takes to follow your dreams. It's based on the novel with the same title by Kajsa Ingemarsson. And it's centers around Agnes, how is a chef that loves cooking. She has a good job, a boyfriend who loves her and a best friend who is always there for her. One day she is both fired from the luxurious restaurant and dumped by her boyfriend. Therefore she has nothing left to loose when a friend asks Agnes if she would like to be part owner in and open up a new restaurant. At the same time she manages to fall in love with the one person who cannot know who she really is.

title: A Light Sleep
description:
Sixteen-year-old Yeo Lin used to have a boyfriend and normal life, but everything changed when she lost both her parents two years ago. To support her siblings, she sells her body. Quietly bearing wounds and responsibilities beyond her age, she faces the cruel trials of love, friendship, and premature adulthood, and she does it all in seeming detachment. Always tired, Yeo Lin suffers from chronic insomnia and relies on medication to sleep. For Yeo Lin, sleep is an escape that she wakes from too soon.

Directed by Lim Seong-chan, the 2008 indie drama A Light Sleep sensitively depicts the ordeals faced by an insomniac high school girl forced to grow up too soon. Teenaged newcomer Choi Ah-jin delivers a mature and compelling performance in the leading role. The film co-stars Yoon Chan and Hong Ah-reum

description: Abbas Al-Abyad is a teacher who traveled to Iraq in search of money, and when he returned, he discovered that he was not alive in the eyes of his family, after missing for years he spent in a prison there.

title: Al Zind: Thi'b Al Assi
description: Assi witnesses his father getting killed in defense of his land. Years later, he returns to his village after his discharge from military service to get revenge, but he finds himself facing Nawras Pasha and his strong influence.

title: Sayedat al akmar al sawdaa
description: In the depths of loneliness and despair, beautiful Aida visits her "tailor," Victoria, a woman who runs a sensual house where erotic fantasies are fulfilled. After satisfying her desires in the arms of one of Victoria's young men, Aida has a haunting nightmare where she envisions herself as a witch who, during a full moon, has the power to destroy her lovers' sensitivity. This disturbing dream sends Aida into a downward spiral of self-destruction. When Aida finally loses her will to live and all hope for salvation, she longs to purify herself and find forgiveness for her sins. Reminiscent of Stanley Kubrick's Eyes Wide Shut and the stylishly erotic films of Radley Metzger, The Lady of the Black Moons emerged from an era of relaxed censorship in Egypt.

title: Like an Actress
description: Anna and Antoine are the perfect tandem on stage and in life, but after many years of marriage and working together, they begin to lose interest in each other. When Antoine decides to leave her, Anna uses the magic of reincarnation to become young and attractive again. But gradually the game turns against her, and Anna realizes that she must choose between her love for her husband and her own life.

title: Yong an Dream
description: Yong an, the capital city, fell into chaos due to the collapse of the West Canal. Wenqi Shen, the Minister of Works in charge of the construction, was implicated overnight and thrown into prison. "When the nest is overturned, no egg remains intact." Wenqi Shen's two daughters, Ran Shen and Zhen Shen, found themselves trapped in a dilemma one after another. Especially Zhen Shen, the youngest daughter, who had always been sheltered in seclusion and was ignorant of the world, now struggled to fend for herself on the streets. During this time, Shiyan Lu, the imperial prosecutor responsible for investigating the case, was perplexed by recurring dreams of his entanglement with a mysterious woman. After verification, he discovered that the mysterious woman in his dreams was Zhen Shen, the daughter of the guilty official. Shiyan Lu gradually approached her, stepping into an unknown fate. As they delved into the West Canal case, they experienced life and death, entrusted each other with faith, and developed a deep affection. With Zhen Shen's help, Shiyan Lu uncovered the truth behind the case. However, the true mastermind was silently closing in on the two of them.

title: Do Demitido ao Temido: Jamais ao Seu Alcance (Dublado)
description: Para cumprir um acordo de noivado, Armando entra no Grupo Almeida e ajuda secretamente Danila a se destacar como empresária. Em troca, recebe desprezo e humilhações. Ferido, ele pede demissão, rompe o noivado e desaparece. Logo, sua verdadeira identidade é revelada: ele é o herdeiro do Grupo Medeiros. Com sua saída, o Grupo Almeida colapsa, e Danila percebe tarde demais o valor do homem que perdeu.

title: Sou Igual ao Amanhecer
description: Amanhe Martins teve seu dia de efetivação transformado em demissão. No mesmo turbilhão, um encontro inesperado com Rafael Moura reescreveu seu destino. Por indicação dele, Amanhe agarrou uma oportunidade na elite das consultorias, a Maxwell. Com resiliência extraordinária, não só se firmou como evoluiu de novata a uma analista senhora de suas funções. Nos cruzamentos profissionais, um afeto sutil nasceu entre ambos, unindo-os. Por trás da imagem impecável de Rafael, escondia-se um medo do amor e uma dificuldade em expressá-lo. Amanhe, com sua empatia e otimismo, curou-o com paciência e doçura, abrindo-lhe, pouco a pouco, as portas do coração. Rafael começou então a desfazer a carapaça fria, aprendendo a relaxar, a aceitar suas imperfeições e a descobrir como expressar amor.

title: Dream Horse [Hindi]
description: Dream Alliance is an unlikely race horse bred by small-town Welsh bartender Jan Vokes. With no experience, Jan convinces her neighbors to chip in their meager earnings to help raise Dream in the hopes he can compete with the racing elites.

description: The well-hidden past of his widowed mother prevents a young man from marrying his girlfriend. When the truth comes to light, his cryptic mother reveals yet another shocking secret, one that only the girl's father knows.

title: Yolcu
description: The railway station in a small town in Western Anatolia where no birds or caravans pass, during the most active and critical days of the National War of Independence in 1921. One is the station chief, who lost his eye and the other foot on the front, and the other was left with caries, and the other was the wife of the station chief.

title: As You Were
description: Oh, those Army daze and nights! An infusion of WAC beauties adds to the fun when ex-G.I. "Dodo" Doubleday (William Tracy), now a hotel clerk, impresses Army brass with his memory and considers going back into the military. But recruiting station sergeant Bill Ames (Joe Sawyer), remembering how Tracy jinxed him back in WWII days, begs him not to re-enlist!

title: Five as Same
description: This is the story of five common girls and their five best friends who are living their individual lives, facing real and humane problems what girls face in Indian Society. They bravely face those problems and challenge the patriarchy in our society.

title: As It Happened
description: From newsprint to radio, from newsreels to television sets in our homes, the 24-hour cable news cycle, the digital information revolution... we find ourselves in a world where news is instantly available through a device in the palm of our hands. How we access news has rapidly and irrevocably evolved over the past century. We now consume news at a rate unprecedented at any time in history. And through all these changes, there has remained one constant: our fascination and hunger for information. "As It Happened" pulls back the curtain on some of the most shocking, notorious and captivating news stories of the past century. Stories that broke around the world, with new details unfolding day after day. Details consumed by an eager public, delivered through the collective experience of news media. From the media frenzy of the Lindbergh baby kidnapping or the televised capture and trial of OJ Simpson. We were on the ground in Iraq as we went to war, in the streets of Paris the night Princess Diana died, and in the Oval Office dissecting the Clinton/Lewinsky affair. These are the stories that started as global news and became media spectacles.

title: Reborn as a Cat
description: Ji Miaomiao, a young woman just starting her career, is betrayed by a friend and left with a mountain of debt. While fleeing from ruthless debt collectors, she accidentally falls from a building. On the brink of death, a mysterious figure transforms her into a cat.

title: Brothers at War
description: An intimate portrait of an American family during a turbulent time. Jake Rademacher sets out to understand the experience, sacrifice, and motivation of his two brothers serving in Iraq. The film follows Jake's exploits as he risks everything-including his life-to tell his brothers' story. Often humorous, but sometimes downright lethal, it is a remarkable journey where Jake embeds with four combat units in Iraq. Unprecedented access to US and Iraqi combat units take him behind the camouflage curtain with secret reconnaissance troops on the Syrian border, into sniper "hide sites" in the Sunni Triangle, through raging machine gun battles with the Iraqi Army. Ultimately, the film follows his brothers home where separations and life-threatening work ripple through their parents, siblings, wives, and children. It is a rare look at the bonds and service of our soldiers on the front lines and the profound effects their service has on the loved ones they leave behind.

title: Life at GJCC
description: This reality series follows the lives of students at Gulfport Job Corps Center, as they go through their daily lives each episode follows some new people and sometimes you may catch them having fun and some days you may see how their school life is and how and what they do after school.

title: Freedom at Midnight S1-S2
description: Is the electrifying story of India's struggle for independence. Based on the bestselling book of the same name, it recounts the partition of India and Pakistan, and the religious and socio-political dynamics of the era.

title: Xin tian long ba bu
description: The master Buddhist of Tubo Kingdom goes to Tianlong Temple for book of secrets of Six Meridian Swords. Tianlong monks give the book to Duan Yu and he keeps the content in mind and destroys the book. The Tubo master catches Duan but Duan runs away. Thus a series of adventures happen all over the territory of Southern Song Dynasty.

title: Bam-seom-hae-jeok-dan seo-ul bul-ba-da
description: The Bamseom Pirates from Korea make music appropriate to our sick society: a hundred songs in ten minutes, that kind of thing. This at times noisy, but also sparkling, activist and often humorous documentary reports on the resistance offered by these punk musicians to hypocritical, conservative money-grabbers and their often violent hold on society.

title: Chasing

The cellphone and gun are very valuable to Seung-Joo and Jung-Taek. The two men must get their items back from the high school students.

title: To Be is Better Than Not to Be
Everything Will Be
description: As dawn breaks and most of the city still sleeps, the long-time merchants of Vancouver's Chinatown are hard at work. They haul out their produce stands and set up their makeshift vendor carts in preparation for what they hope will be a busy day. But, like many ethnic enclaves in urban centres across North America, their clientele is dwindling. This once vibrant and thriving neighbourhood is in flux as new condo developments and non-Chinese businesses move in and gradually overtake the declining hub of the Chinese community. Everything Will Be, from Sundance award-winning director Julia Kwan, captures this fascinating transformation through the intimate perspectives of the neighbourhood's residents, diverse merchants and new entrepreneurs, who offer their poignant reflections on change, memory and legacy. A public art installation erected on the roof of a local real estate mogul's contemporary art gallery - housed in one of the oldest buildings in Chinatown - illuminates in neon the words 'EVERYTHING IS GOING TO BE ALRIGHT.' Night and day, this sign looms over Chinatown. Everything is going to be alright. The big question is - for whom?

title: A Noite e a Madrugada
description: The intimate conflicts of smugglers and vagabonds, along with the struggle of the peasants against the attempts of the bourgeoisie and the State, to take possession of the vacancies they cultivate.

title: A House Without a Father
description: Early morning at the Scotts' house.

title: Quando a Lealdade Dele Chegou a Zero
description: Mia consegue ver uma pontuação de lealdade flutuando sobre cada cabeça. Seu amor de infância, Jack, manteve um cem perfeito por seis anos, até o ciúme se infiltrar e o número começar a cair. Quando ele se volta para a garota que chama de seu raio de sol, Mia não chora nem implora. Ela vai embora. Focando na própria corrida, ela se sente atraída pelo quieto Ethan, cujo cem nunca vacilou desde o dia em que o puxou para um grupo de educação física anos atrás. Jack afunda ao implorar, a segue de perto e usa artimanhas para reconquistá-la, mas Mia não corre mais atrás de promessas vazias. Ela escolheu aquele cujo número nunca caiu.

title: A White Man Walks Into A Barbershop
description: Filmmaker Kyle Schickner hits the road, crisscrossing America with the hope of examining racism's hold on our country, only to discover the grip racism has on him. Visiting barbershops, churches, and homes from Alabama to Minneapolis, from D.C to L.A, this honest, humorous, searing documentary pulls the veil away from white liberal ideology and the social warriors who use race and cancel culture as a weapon. See what happens when - A White Man Walks Into A Barbershop.

title: May Brent, Ralph at Michael! Miss Q&A candidates, WINNER sa kilig!
description:
Ngayong July 3 and every day, ang tawanan sa "It's Showtime ay free. Kasama ang mga kandidata ng Miss Q and A, ang good vibes ay times three!

Sina Agua ng Parañaque City, Raux Araneta ng Negros Occidental at Kyla ng Laguna, kanya-kanyang paandar sa pagpapakilala sa Madlang People. Pero ang pinakagusto nilang makilala, eh 'di ang mga crush nila! Parang Valentine's season sa buwan ng Hulyo, kilig ng ladies ay todo-todo dahil kina Michael Sager, Ralph de Leon, at Brent Manalo.

Pero hindi lang crush ang kayang nilang ipaglaban, dahil pati sa social issues ay hindi matitinag ang kanilang paninindigan. Syempre, namana nila ang tapang ni Vice Ganda, na hindi matatakot 'ipahiya' ang mga magnanakaw, lalo na 'yung mga sangkot sa flood control scam, kung sakaling makasabay niya ito sa daan. Pero kung guwardiyado ang magnanakaw, teka lang, ibang usapan na 'yan.

Mukhang na-inspire ang mga kandidata kina Michael, Ralph at Brent dahil sa unang round ay mabilis ang kanilang pagpindot at pagsagot. Sina Agua at Raux ang nanguna sa Tumpak Ganern at nag-face off sa Round 2 na Wit Lang.

Parehong magaling! Mga answers nila ay winning! Kaya naman 'it's a tie' ang resulta. Sa araw na 'to, mayroon tayong dalawang Miss Q&A Reyna TalakEra.

Sa pinakabagong inaabangan na 'teleserye' sa tanghalian, ang You Gotta Lyric portion ng Laro Laro Pick, pang-finale ang eksena nina Vice Ganda bilang MemeRimar at Vhong Navarro bilang Sergio.

title: Hosts Miss Q&A candidates nag reveal ng LOVE STATUS
description:
Anuman ang status ng 'yong puso, saktong-sakto ang happiness at good vibes na hatid ng "Showtime Online U" squad na nagse-celebrate ng 10th anniversary.

PaLOVEan sa rampahan at talakan sina Miss Q and A candidates Callout Everdean, Adam Lambert, at Cali Serion.

Feeling reyna agad si Callout dahil sa winner niyang love life. Ipinakilala ng kandidata ang kanyang American husband. Ibang mukha ng pag-ibig naman ang ipinakita ni Adam, na focused muna sa career dahil na-trauma sa past relationship. Si Cali naman na isang iskolar ng bayan, pag-ibig ng ina ang inaasam.

Dahil napag-uusapan na ang pag-ibig, naisip ni Vice na alamin ang love status ng "It's Showtime" hosts. Na-intriga ang Madlang People sa mga status nina Kim Chiu, Darren Espanto, at Jackie Gonzaga. Pero ang status na pinakatumagos sa puso ng hosts at Madlang People, 'yung sinabi ni Ryan Bang, "Nadurog parang paminta. Pero may bubuo. Sino kaya?"

Agad nakapasok ang University of the Philippines student na si Cali sa Wit Lang round, kung saan ibinuhos niya ang puso sa tanong na, "Ano ang gagawin mo kung sa sobrang bait mo handa ka nang kunin ni Lord?" In-enjoy naman ni Adam ang talak sa tanong na, "Ano ang nararamdaman ng valid ID na laging dalawa silang hinahanap?"

Dahil sumilip na ang Haring Araw, extra sunny at bubbly ang mood ng mga taga-Malinta, Valenzuela na sumalang sa Laro Laro Pick game arena.

Nakakuwentuhan ng hosts si Angel, isang masipag na nanay. Sa kanilang usapan, napa-isip si Vice Ganda sa pagkakaiba ng bawat henerasyon. Kaya nga ba minsan 'magulo' ang mundo dahil sa pagsasama-sama ng iba't ibang henerasyon?

Sumikat ang swerte kay JM matapos niyang malampasan ang lahat ng challenges. Umabot sa P30,000 ang Li-Pot offer at sinubukan pa ni Kim na kumbinsihin si JM na tanggapin ito. Pero hindi nagpatinag si JM at sinugalan ang POT question. Magtagumpay kaya si JM at maiuwi ang P300,000 POT money?

title: A Song of Loves: R. David Buzaglo
description: Rabbi David Buzaglo was the greatest Hebrew liturgical poet of the twentieth century. Born in Morocco in 1903, his literary output had a major impact on a community of hundreds of thousands of people. From his prolific period in the Diaspora to the years he spent in a ruptured Israel, Buzaglo's poetry initiated an abrupt shift in Sephardic liturgical writing, but it also served as a vital link between the modern era and a tradition that dates back to Spanish Jewry's Golden Age. But Buzaglo was more than just a great poet. The actions he took at seminal moments in history had a critical impact in shaping the identity of Maghreb Jews. This film is an intimate look at Buzaglo's life and career, from its roots in the rich tradition of Hebrew poetry in Morocco through the liturgical revolution in Israel.

title: I Am Nasrine
description: When you change where you are do you change who you are? I Am Nasrine is an intimate journey of self-discovery and ultimately reveals the unfolding of a soul. Set in modern day Tehran, and the UK, the film follows the paths of Nasrine and Ali, sister and brother in a comfortable, middle class Iranian home. When Nasrine has a run-in with the police, the punishment is more than she bargained for. At her father's bidding, Nasrine and Ali set out for the UK, torn about leaving behind their home and all that they know, embarking on a reluctant exile. Still, for Nasrine, there is undeniable excitement about the prospect of starting a new life in the West, and an eagerness for its promise of new freedoms. Arriving in Britain, their fate and their future are far from certain. Nasrine is quick to settle into her new life, making friends, forming bonds, including Nichole from the gypsy/travelers community. All the while her brother Ali struggles with the realities of life in the UK and his awakening sexuality. Then comes 9/11. Their parents will be unable to join them in Britain, leaving them quite alone. Things spiral further out of control when an unimaginable tragedy occurs. Nasrine must discover an incredible courage within her to accept what fate has dealt her; discovering that the end of her journey is really just the beginning. Can hope, simple untainted hope, overcome the darkest of tragedies? I Am Nasrine explores these questions and more, and offers answers that are sure to surprise.

title: Linda, Be Good
description: Linda Prentiss joins a burlesque troupe to get information for a novel she is writing without her husband, Roger Prentiss, knowing about it. Not knowing who he is, she meets her husband's boss, Sam Thompson, while on a night-clubbing tour with the show's burlesque queen Margie LaVitte. Later, the boss takes a client and Roger to the burlesque show, and Roger is stunned to see his wife as one of the stars.

title: I'll Be There
description: Scarred from her father Poch (Gabby Concepcion) leaving 15 years ago, New York-based Maximina dela Cerna (KC Concepcion) meets him in the Philippines to claim her inheritance left by her mom to make her dreams in New York come true. But Poch, hoping to reconnect with his daughter, asks her to live with him in Sta. Elena for 30 days before giving her what she needs. Though unable to stand her father, Maxi is left with no choice but to agree. It is in Sta. Elena that Maxi meets Tommy (Jericho Rosales), a fun-loving single father who gives Maxi his frank but insightful opinions about her angst towards her father. Through this, Maxi learns to open herself to seeing Poch in a new light, allowing for them to close off their past wounds and start again. But as they slowly learn to become father and daughter again, will Maxi be able to give up her aspirations to live with her father? Will Poch be able to let go of the daughter he waited so long to be with? After leaving, and being left behind, does one ever stop knowing how to love?

title: My Little Baby
description: Jung Han, a top murder squad detective in the special investigation bureau of violent crimes becomes the sole guardian of his 6-month-old niece, Eun Ae when his sister and her husband pass away unexpectedly.

title: Salma w Sari
description: Salma and Sari is about two young Palestinians who find themselves in a situation they weren't ready for. The series is set in East Jerusalem, where life under Israeli occupation is stressful and pressure leads to aggression. Their friends and family make it difficult for them to make their own decisions and follow their dreams. Salma is only eighteen. She grew up without a father, and pressure on her mother to protect Salma from society grows. Salma has a passion for photography, and struggles to convince her mother to support her goals. She has to take matters into her own hands, to follow her dreams, whatever the cost. Sari didn't go to college and works at his family business. He's good at what he does, but that's not good enough for his family. As he reaches the age of twenty four, his family insists it's time to marry and start a family. Sari's friends have different plans for him. They are young, bored, and love cars. And you know what that means - trouble. This creative drama for social change is set in East Jerusalem and other areas in the West Bank.

title: Charlie at Will
description:
Gloomy man ang weather lately, nakulayan naman ng pink ang ating Tuesday dahil si Maki, umappear sa It’s Showtime at pinerform ang latest single niya na “habangbuhay pansamantala”!

Malungkot at heartbreaking man ang lyrics ng kanta niya, napa-happy naman tayo ni Maki dahil sa good vibes at energy niyang dala, lalo pa nang sumabak sa “Oooh Lala Baby” dance challenge kasama ang Baby Dolls. Super game si Maki sa paggiling, to the point na hinamon pa niya ang host na si Darren Espanto sa isang dance showdown na ikinaaliw naman ng lahat.

Hindi lang si Maki ang nakisaya sa Showtime fam, kundi pati na rin sina Sue Ramirez at Rico Blanco upang imbitahan ang lahat na panoorin at suportahan ang upcoming movie nila na “Project Baby.” Tila naman nawala nang sandali ang angas ng OPM rock icon dahil napasabak din sila ni Sue sa “Oooh Lala Baby” dance challenge.

Samantala, labindalawang groovy at energetic senior citizens mula Navotas City ang naglaro sa “Laro Laro Pick.” Nakipagkuwetuhan at nakipagkulitan ang hosts na sina Vice Ganda, Jhong Hilario, at Vhong Navarro kina Nanay Baby, Nanay Felly, at Tatay Elly na magiliw na nagbahagi ng kanilang buhay at bonding moments kasama ang kanilang mga mahal na anak at apo.

Dahil wala sa mga kalahok ang nakaabot sa jackpot round, kinailangan ni Vice na bumunot ng isang pangalan mula sa kanila na magkakaroon ng tsansang mag-uwi ng P150,000. Hindi man pinalad si Tatay Elly sa unang sabak niya, nabigyan naman siya ng ikalawang pagkakataon na magpatuloy sa laro dahil siya ang masuwerteng napili ni Vice.

Nahalina man siya noong una nina Ate Girl Jackie Gonzaga at Kim Chiu sa offer nilang P30,000, biglang nagbago ang isip ni Tatay Elly at nag-desisyong mag-POT matapos na sabihin ni Vice Ganda sa kanya na ang jackpot question ay may kinalaman sa eleksyon. Bilang proud botante ng Navotas City, tila nakaramdam siya ng confidence na masasagot niya ang katanungan.

Sa kasawiang-palad, hindi nasagot nang tama ni Tatay Elly ang katanungang, “Ano ang minimum na edad ng isang kandidato upang makatakbo bilang pangulo ng Pilipinas?” Gayunpaman, hindi naman hinayaan ni Vice na umuwi siyang P1,000 lang ang dala dahil nangako siyang bibigyan ito ng P10,000 bilang pantulong sa pambili niya ng maintenance medicines.

Para sa ikalawang araw ng national finals ng “Tawag ng Tanghalan” Year 10, sina Charlie Palalisan ng General Santos City, Arbasa Abdulkarim ng Tawi-Tawi, at Will de Sosa ng Carmona, Cavite ang naglaban-laban upang mapabilib ang mga huradong sina Sofronio Vasquez, Klarisse de Guzman, and Ogie Alcasid.

Unang sumalang sa tanghalan ang aspiring lawyer ay miyembro ng B’laan tribe na si Charlie, na pinamangha ang lahat sa makabagbag-damdamin niyang rendisyon ng “Tulog Na” ng Sugarfree. Sumunod na nagtanghal ang high school teacher at proud haligi ng tahanan na si Arbasa, na sinubukang kilitiin ang lahat sa version niya ng “Your Man” ni American artist Josh Turner. Panghuli ay si Will, na inentertain ang lahat sa kakaibang twist na nilapat niya sa “Mr. Suave” ng Parokya ni Edgar.

Sa huli, ang mga pambato ng Region 12 (SOCKSARGEN) na si Charlie at ng Region 4 (Calabarzon at Mimaropa) na si Will ang mga idineklarang pasok na sa grand finals, matapos na makakuha ng scores na 94.3% at 91.3%, respectively. Samantala, si Arbasa naman ay nakatanggap lamang ng 90.3%.

title: The Detective Is Already Dead [Hindi]
description: Kimizuka Kimihiko is a crisis-magnet. From getting caught up in a crime scene to accidentally witnessing a drug deal, trouble seems to find him around every corner. So it is no surprise when his rather mundane flight suddenly enters a state of emergency with a dire need of a detective onboard. Unfortunately, his attempt at avoiding trouble is foiled by a beautiful girl with silver hair who goes by the codename Siesta. Declaring herself a detective, she unceremoniously drags Kimizuka into the case as her assistant. That incident spelled the beginning of an adventure around the globe that went beyond his wildest imagination. Putting their lives on the line, the two took down criminal organizations, prevented disasters, and saved thousands. But the curtain closed to their epic journey with Siesta's untimely death three years later. Resolving to live an ordinary high school life this time, Kimizuka spends a year maintaining a low profile. However, as fate would have it, a girl with an uncanny resemblance to Siesta comes crashing into his life, threatening to throw his peaceful days into disarray.

title: Scientific Thinking
description:
In 7 episodes, Crash Course Scientific Thinking will teach learners the foundational principles underlying scientific thought, pulling back the curtain on processes like peer review, interrogating what makes sources reliable (or not), unpacking how consensus is reached, and revealing how scientific understanding changes over time. Ultimately, learners will gain the ability to think more critically about the scientific information they encounter in their everyday lives. 

Series Objectives
- Describe the dynamic, communal nature of science, articulating the roles of uncertainty and consensus.
- Explain the role of peer review and replication in science.
- Unpack the potential for bias and error in science and understand its self-correction mechanisms.
- Understand the role of specialization in scientific expertise.
- Interpret primary, secondary, and tertiary sources, and use lateral reading to verify claims.
- Understand basic statistical language used to describe scientific findings.

title: English for Career Development
description:
Welcome to English for Career Development, a course created by the University of Pennsylvania, and funded by the U.S. Department of State Bureau of Educational and Cultural Affairs, Office of English Language Programs. 
To enroll in this course for free, click on “Enroll now” and then select "Full Course. No certificate."
This course is designed for non-native English speakers who are interested in advancing their careers in the global marketplace. In this course, you will learn about the job search, application, and interview process in the United States, while comparing and contrasting the same process in your home country. This course will also give you the opportunity to explore your global career path, while building your vocabulary and improving your language skills to achieve your professional goals. The first unit in this course will introduce the U.S. job application process and provide strategies for identifying the jobs that match your interests and skills. Unit 2 will take you through the steps necessary to produce a professional-looking resume. In unit 3, you will work to develop a clear and concise cover letter. The final unit of the course focuses on networking and interview skills.
Anyone may take this course for free. If you want to get a Coursera Verified Certificate for free, please fill out the Financial Aid form.
 Unless otherwise noted, all course materials are available for re-use, repurposing and free distribution under a Creative Commons 4.0 Attribution license.
Supplemental reading materials were provided by Newsela, which publishes daily news articles at a level that's just right for each English language learner.

title: Programming with JavaScript
description: JavaScript is the programming language that powers the modern web. In this course, you will learn the basic concepts of web development with JavaScript. You will work with functions, objects, arrays, variables, data types, the HTML DOM, and much more. You will learn how to use JavaScript and discover interactive possibilities with modern JavaScript technologies. Finally, you will learn about the practice of testing code and how to write a unit test using Jest.

title: Business English: Capstone Project
description:
The capstone project will give you opportunities to demonstrate your competence in the learning objectives for this Specialization. For the project, you’ll use formal, written methods and more casual visual and audio methods of communication to demonstrate your ability to use language appropriate for different business contexts. The goal of this course is to demonstrate competence in writing and presenting a plan using skills and language appropriate for business.
Course Learning Objectives
•	Use appropriate vocabulary to write a mini business plan
•	Communicate a business plan orally in an organized and engaging presentation

title: Databases and SQL for Data Science with Python
description:
Working knowledge of SQL (or Structured Query Language) is a must for data professionals like Data Scientists, Data Analysts and Data Engineers. Much of the world's data resides in databases. SQL is a powerful language used for communicating with and extracting data from databases.
In this course you will learn SQL inside out- from the very basics of Select statements to
advanced concepts like JOINs. 
You will: 
-write foundational SQL statements like: SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, and DELETE 
-filter result sets, use WHERE, COUNT, DISTINCT, and LIMIT clauses 
-differentiate between DML & DDL 
-CREATE, ALTER, DROP and load tables 
-use string patterns and ranges; ORDER and GROUP result sets, and built-in database functions
-build sub-queries and query data from multiple tables 
-access databases as a data scientist using Jupyter notebooks with SQL and Python
-work with advanced concepts like Stored Procedures, Views, ACID Transactions, Inner & Outer JOINs through hands-on labs and projects
You will practice building SQL queries, work with real databases on the Cloud, and use real data science tools. 
In the final project you’ll analyze multiple real-world datasets to demonstrate your skills.

title: My Unicorn Girl [Hindi]
description: When she was eighteen, Sang Tian makes a wish to enter her mother's school to become part of the Chinese figure skating team. However, she did not pass the ranking test but somehow disguises as a guy and was accepted into the Ice Hockey team. Having no choice, she adopted a new identity. However, her plan was foiled by the sudden appearance of Wen Bing. Wen Bing and Sang Tian become room-mates. After one encounter, the two former "arch enemies" suddenly become good friends. The two of them decide to work together with their team mates and do their best in the championships. However, Sang Tian's secret was eventually exposed. Despite this, she still gets the chance to become a member of the first all-female Ice Hockey team. Sang Tian is finally able to become a real girl and continue chasing her dream.

title: The Rising Son - From Shame to Supremacy
description: Micro Drama

title: Sauda Pyaar Ka
description: Sauda Pyaar Ka is an emotional romance where a humble tailor secretly lives a double life as India's biggest fashion tycoon. While he sacrifices everything for the woman he loves, she betrays him for wealth and status—only to discover his true identity when it's too late. A story of love, heartbreak, betrayal, and redemption.

title: My PA is a Political Prince
description:
My PA Is a Political Prince

Fearless activist Riya dreams of changing the world, unaware that her unpaid PA, Aryaman, is actually the heir to a powerful political dynasty. As love grows between them, ambitious politician Vikram pulls Riya into a dangerous world of fame and power. Torn between love and ambition, Riya must discover who truly stands by her before she loses everything.

title: Mere Papa Heeralal
description: When a self-made billionaire CEO is forced to fake a marriage with a poor lift mechanic to protect her son and save her empire, neither of them realizes that they are actually reunited lovers, the child's real parents, and heirs to a secret that will shake Mumbai's most powerful families.

title: Cruel Attraction
description: After being framed and imprisoned for a crime she didn't commit, Chandni returns home determined to find her missing younger sister. Forced into a dangerous deal with the notorious playboy Luv Rathore, she agrees to seduce his golden-boy brother Kush as part of a revenge scheme. But as buried secrets surface, Chandni discovers that one brother may be the villain everyone loves—and the other may be the devil willing to save her.

title: The Gangster King
description: Veer is secretly a super powerful  and influential man controlling pokiticians and business men, while he pretends to be a cleaner - and ends up in a contract marriage with a businesswoman, whom he protects and gradually falls for. This businesswoman, Tara, faces problems created by her own family members along with a powerful and dangerous man - but Veer is too powerful and influential for all of them. He overpowers all the problems, while hiding his reality all this time.

title: Super Dad Sunil Tyagi
description: A scrap dealer secretly living as a billionaire tests his daughter’s strength and love. When her rich fiancé betrays and humiliates them, the truth is revealed—bringing justice, redemption, and proving that real wealth is character, not money.

title: Khoon Ka Rishta [Hindi]
description: When blind but brilliant photographer Zoya crosses paths with brooding businessman Yug Singhania, sparks fly in unexpected ways. As love blossoms through secrets, emotional wounds, and societal barriers, Zoya becomes Yug’s guiding light and he becomes her strength. Together, they discover that true vision comes not from the eyes, but from the heart.

title: The Triple Crown
description: After a fatal accident, a delivery boy is reincarnated as a weak scholar in an ancient village. Guided by a stylish genie, he must navigate a new life while married to a princess, a warrior, and a merchant’s daughter. Using modern knowledge and magical boons, he protects his home from bandits and corrupt soldiers. As he wins his wives' devotion, he transforms from a "mad bookworm" into a powerful, beloved ruler.

title: Ajnabi Rishta
description:
Baby Loading Pyaar Pending is an engaging story of a pregnant college student, who fights stigma, poverty, and heartbreak while hiding a marriage born of sacrifice.
A powerful CEO unknowingly crosses paths with the wife he once rejected. Fate forces truth, redemption, and love to reunite a broken family. Watch now.

title: Who picked Mr. Fu's Rose [Hindi]
description: Who picked Mr. Fu's Rose

title: Ajnabi ka Intezar Hai
description: A broken woman, robbed of motherhood, finds unexpected love in a humble construction worker—unaware he’s a secret billionaire hiding his true identity. As their fragile romance deepens, dark secrets, betrayal, and a stolen child resurface, forcing them to fight against fate, enemies, and shattered trust to claim the family they were destined for.

title: Love Gamble
description: Love Gamble is a drama mini-series that follows the unlikely connection between a wealthy nightclub owner and a struggling young woman. The story begins when Litika, a homeless woman, rescues an expensive watch belonging to Nishant Singhaniya, a powerful club owner. Grateful and intrigued, Nishant brings Litika into his world, offering her a job and a place to stay.

title: Don In Uniform
description: Yash, ek underworld don, school ke ladke Rahul ko bachate hue maara gaya, aur uski aatma Rahul ke andar bas gayi. Kamzor aur bechaara Rahul, jise sab kam aankte the, ab Yash ki taakat aur swag ke saath badalne laga. Yash ne Rahul ko sambhalne aur uska graduation ka sapna poora karne ka faisla kiya. School mein Rahul hero ban gaya, ladkiyan uske charm ki deewani ho gayi. Lekin padhai aur beeta hua past uske liye badi chunauti ban gaye. Kahi Yash Rahul ko apni tarah criminal to nahi bana dega?

title: Billionaire's Journey From Kanpur To London
description: A secret billionaire endures years of abuse from his ungrateful wife in London before reclaiming his Indian empire and a new life. After a high-stakes plane crisis, he finds true love with a kind flight attendant who respected him even when he posed as a lowly cleaner. When his bankrupt ex-wife unknowingly returns to beg for his investment, she is publicly exposed and disgraced. The humble hero and his new queen ultimately unite their worlds of immense wealth and rural tradition.

title: Billionaire ka Safar
description: In a single day, aboard a train heading back to his village, billionaire Rajat Mhatre’s worlds collide—his hidden identity, his forgotten family, and the ruthless man who tormented them. What begins as a journey home turns into a battle for dignity, justice, and truth. As the village celebrates a grand resort project led by the arrogant Nitin, they are unaware that the real power - “The Silver Lord” - has arrived to reclaim everything that was once stripped from him.

title: Breakup Se Bana Billionaire
description: After being dumped at the marriage registrar for a richer man, struggling techie Aditya impulsively marries a stranger, Preeti, unaware she is a billionaire CEO. What begins as a deal-driven marriage turns explosive when Aditya is revealed to be the long-lost heir of a powerful business family, and the very man who humiliated him becomes his rival. As love, identity, and ambition collide, Aditya must choose between revenge, legacy, and the woman who believed in him first.

title: Queen Of Snakes
description: Devika thought she had found love, only to discover her husband, Vikrant, was a prince who conspired to destroy her unborn child. Brutalized by his lawful wife and carrying the bloodline of an enemy who wiped out her village, Devika was forced to embrace her identity as a powerful Naag Kanya. As ancient curses flared, she watched her betrayers rot from within, proving that no one escapes the bite of karma.

title: Unknown Connection
description: Ananya is told her newborn twins died, but her step-sister Sonal secretly sold them to Aradhya. Seven years later, Ananya meets wealthy CEO Arjun (posing as a driver) and his twins—her biological children. As she bonds with them, Aradhya returns claiming her "family," while Sonal's torment continues. Birthmarks and connections reveal the truth: Sonal's betrayal, Aradhya's fake pregnancy, and Arjun's deception. Ananya reunites with her children and marries Arjun.

title: Pati, Patni aur Dhokha
description: Pati, Patni aur Dhokha ek intense relationship thriller hai jo marriage, infidelity aur obsession ke dark side ko explore karta hai. Yeh kahani ek aurat ke tootne aur phir apne aap ko dobara khada karne ki journey hai. Show poochta hai—kya pyaar ke naam par har zulm maaf ho sakta hai? Aur jab ek aurat apni had se aage badh jaaye, toh kya woh victim rehti hai ya hunter ban jaati hai?

title: My Crazy Ex-Girlfriend
description: Hardik Goyal’s perfect life collapses when he loses his company, reputation, and fiancée overnight. Betrayed and broken, fate pulls him into the shadowy world of the mafia, where power replaces principles. As danger escalates, Hardik reconnects with Niharika, his childhood savior, discovering love, strength, and destiny. Choosing the mafia becomes his only way to protect love, family, and his future.

title: The Layoff That Shook the Company [Hindi]
description: In a high-stakes world of corporate power and betrayal, former tech prodigy Ethan finds himself caught between loyalty and revenge. As the mighty Blackwell Group crumbles due to internal politics and personal vendettas, Ethan must decide whether to save the empire that wronged him—or let it burn. A gripping tale of ambition, heartbreak, and redemption in the ruthless tech industry.

title: Sweet Revenge
description: Sweet Revenge is a dramatic tale of love, betrayal, and justice. Rachit, a devoted husband and real author behind his wife Prerna’s success, sacrifices everything for her—only to be cheated, framed, and abandoned. As truth unfolds, Rachit rises to reclaim his identity, expose deceit, and find true love, while Prerna faces the consequences of her greed. Watch now.

title: Delivery Boy Vs Billionaires
description: Billionaire is mistaken as a Delivery Boy.

title: The Billionaire's Deal
description: The Billionaire's Deal is a modern love-hate saga between Yukanika , a shy medical student burdened by her family’s debts, and Vikrant , a cold, arrogant billionaire with a dark past. When fate forces Yukanika to work as Vikrant’s personal secretary to repay her late father’s loan, sparks ignite between the fiery opposites. What begins as a battle, but slowly turns into a desire, power, and redemption, where love might heal the beast or destroy the beauty forever. Watch now!

title: The Ba***ds of Boardroom [Tamil]
description: The Ba***ds of Boardroom is an engaging story of a mother sacrifices everything to raise a child she believes is hers. Betrayal, greed, and blood ties collide inside boardrooms and bedrooms alike. When the final chess move is revealed, only one woman stands victorious. Watch now.

title: Billionaire Groom is my new husband
description: Billionaire Groom is my new husband

title: My Husband Is A Ghost Hunter
description: Naina , a widowed gold magnate, marries Arjun Varma to protect her daughter and her collapsing empire, believing he is only a broken ex-convict. When powerful gold syndicates attack her business and target her child, a buried truth explodes. Her husband Arjun Varma is actually Ghost Hunter, a man once feared by governments and erased from history. As a contract marriage turns real, a caged monster rises to protect his family and claim his throne.

title: Billion Dollar Mess [Telugu]
description: When airline tycoon Veer Chopra falls for the charming flight attendant Lara Smith, he thinks he has found his perfect match. But when his unsuspecting parents, Rajesh and Vinita Chopra, fly in to meet their future daughter-in-law, a shocking web of arrogance, deception, and humiliation unfolds mid-air turning love into the costliest mistake of Veer’s life.

title: Vaikuntapuramlo [Telugu]
description: A successful CEO finally finds the son he lost 20 years ago after years of struggle. But just when he thinks life has given him back what he lost, shocking twists turn his world upside down. This is a family drama filled with suspense and twist upon twist.

title: Ladies Man [Telugu]
description: Ladies Man

title: Dear Husband [Kannada]
description: Ruhi apne daagon ko chhupate-chhupate pyaar, dhokhe aur dushmanon ki saazishon mein ulajh jaati hai. Har mod par Arjun ke saath uska rishta ek nayi kasauti se guzarta hai.

title: Still Waiting for Love [Kannada]
description: Still Waiting for Love

title: The Hidden Prince
description: The Hidden Prince

title: Desperate Cage: Miss Sun Fights Back : Kannada
description: Desperate Cage: Miss Sun Fights Back : Kannada

title: The Exiled Heavy Knight Knows How to Game the System [Hindi]
description: Elymas awakens the "flawed" Heavy Knight class and is disowned. Realizing this world mirrors a VR game he mastered, he uses this secret knowledge to prove the "weakest" class is strongest.

title: SPY x FAMILY [Hindi]
description:
Everyone has a part of themselves they cannot show to anyone else.

At a time when all nations of the world were involved in a fierce war of information happening behind closed doors, Ostania and Westalis had been in a state of cold war against one another for decades. The Westalis Intelligence Services' Eastern-Focused Division (WISE) sends their most talented spy, "Twilight," on a top-secret mission to investigate the movements of Donovan Desmond, the chairman of Ostania's National Unity Party, who is threatening peace efforts between the two nations.

This mission is known as "Operation Strix." It consists of "putting together a family in one week in order to infiltrate social gatherings organized by the elite school that Desmond's son attends."

"Twilight" takes on the identity of psychiatrist Loid Forger and starts looking for family members. But Anya, the daughter he adopts, turns out to have the ability to read people's minds, while his wife, Yor, is an assassin! With it being in each of their own interests to keep these facts hidden, they start living together while concealing their true identities from one another.
World peace is now in the hands of this brand-new family as they embark on an adventure full of surprises.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

title: Beyoncé: Queen B
description: One of the most recognisable figures in contemporary music, Beyoncé rose to fame as the central member of pop-R&B group Destiny's Child before embarking on a multi-platinum, record-breaking solo career in 2001. Booming record sales, Grammy awards, movie roles, and marriage to rapper and CEO Jay-Z, combined to heighten her profile in the 2000s. Billboard named her female artist of the decade, while the R.I.A.A. acknowledged that, through 64 gold and platinum certifications, she was the decade's top-selling artist. Once she released her fifth solo album in 2013, it was evident that the singer, songwriter, and dancer wasn't merely an entertainer but a progressive artist as well. Get lost in the ultimate story of modern day super-stardom, as we take you through the incredible Journey of Beyoncé.

title: B-city
description: B-City follows four crazy childhood friends who live in Baltimore City as they carry out their everyday lives and relationships through hysterical and sometimes complex situation. The guy version of the show Girlfriends , each character has their own unique personality that seems to get them in and out of predicaments.

title: Jean-Gina B.
description: This film is based on the true story of Jean Bella, who served as an officer in the Belgian Marine while being convinced, from an early age, that he was in fact a woman. Director Jean-Pol Ferbus follows Jean Bella and makes him talk about his life, psychological and spiritual experiences and reveals the true poet who remained undisclosed for most of this person's life. The film ultimately isn't about transexuality but about loneliness one can experience when he/she feels very deeply that she/he belongs to the two sexes and this in a deep, almost religious, fashion, to such an extent that sexuality itself is being erased from one's life. Jean-Gina Bella is a woman in the body of a man who bravely lived a life on the sea, eventually fighting the elements, talking to God when lost on the immense solitary ocean. This testimony is a very touching and poetic one.

title: B-Daman Fireblast
description: The show takes place in "Crest Land", set after the mysterious "B-Crystal" went berserk at the WBMA Headquarters. The main protagonist, Kamon Day, lives in the south area of Crest Land, and is an energetic boy who loves B-Daman. However, he lost his all past memories of B-Daman and his family, except for his big sister Aona who lives with him. One day, Kamon meets Garuburn, a B-Daman, at his local B-Daman shop, "B-Junk", and he finds Garuburn strangely familiar. Garuburn becomes his partner, and he returns to the B-Daman battles once again.

title: Organism 46-B: The Unseen
description: Trapped beneath four kilometers of Antarctic ice, scientists awaken an ancient predator, a shape-shifting horror who mimics its prey and controls the mind. Paranoia sets in, survival is now not just about escape...but knowing who to trust.

title: Waiting for B.
description: A group of Beyoncé's fans camped-out for two months to be the first in line for her 2013 concert in Sao Paulo, Brazil. This film is an intimate portrait of the these fans and their day-to-day lives in camp and off.

title: Reunion: The Sound of the Providence [Hindi]
description: A decade has passed since the tomb-raiders Wu Xie, Wang Pang Zi, and Zhang Qi Ling went on their last tomb-raiding mission but when Wu Xie receives a mysterious text from his missing uncle, he calls upon the other two to investigate.

title: What If I'm One Hell of A Fighter
description: After his father dies, Kane is taken in by Eve, a gym owner. Bullied as a janitor, he hides his skills until gangsters threaten the gym. Months later, the gym thrives. Kane and Eve find family and purpose together.

title: Georgekutty C/O Georgekutty
description: George Kutty (Jayaram) is a hard working student, who graduated with top rank in college as an engineer. His family which was once rich is burdened in debt. His father meets with Chandi (Jagathi) a marriage broker who proposes a match for Georgekutty with a rich family, but they would have to lie a little about their economic status. George Kutty resists first, but pressure from his dad who sees the marriage as a way to get money to payback the family debts, he agrees. Unfortunately the father-in-law, Itichan, finds out the truth about the family and confronts them. Though Itichan is very angry he agrees to the wedding since he already planned the wedding as a way to showoff to his enemies. He makes Georgekutty and his family agree to certain terms for the wedding to take place including that Georgekutty and his wife have to stay in their house with them. After the wedding Georgekutty sees that he and visiting family and friends are disrespected, and that he is controlled and held like a prisoner at Itichan's house. Georgekutty comes up with a plan to get back at his father-in-law which forms rest of the movie.

description: An autobiographical film about the trials and travails of an Emmy Award winning director/editor who stuttered his way through the Hollywood meat grinder and survived to stutter about it.

description: Seeking to recover his memories, a scissor-wielding hairdresser, bungling quasi-assassin stumbles into a struggle for power among three feuding factions.
