title: How to be RICH
description: Broke valet Connor Walsh struggles to save his dying sister while enduring humiliation from his gold-digging fiancée and her wealthy lover. When a mysterious app called MIDAS grants him billions for completing missions, Connor rises from poverty to unimaginable wealth. But as powerful enemies threaten everything he's built, he must prove he can succeed without the system's help—and discover that true wealth is more than money.

title: Big Brother
description: A reborn cultivator in ancient times focuses on survival by avoiding karma and mastering defensive skills. His peaceful life of cultivation changes when his master introduces a new disciple to their mountain sanctuary.

title: Against the sky Supreme [English]
description: The entire universe is divided into the inner universe and the outer universe. The two universes are enemies of each other. The outer universe is ruled by demons, and the inner universe is divided into The Realm of gods, the Eternal Realm, and the Mortal Realm. In the universe, there are countless mortal worlds like the Tianfa Continent, and they are collectively referred to as the Jiutian Xin Region. In the field of Jiutian Xin, nine immortal emperors commanded all star fields in nine layers. Above the nine heavens is the realm of purification of immortal gods.

title: Plan C-14 II
description:
Martin, an 83-year-old industrious man, will embark on a unique journey at 14.000 ft through the deserted highlands of the Argentine Andes mountains.

Plan C-14 II blends an air of melancholy and beauty as we admire the life of Martin Pueyrredon. He's 83 years old and has recently lost his wife of 60 years, followed by his best friend and traveling partner, with whom his outdoor adventures had taken on profound meaning. Their deaths leave him empty, even as he declares himself a "happy old man." He continues to work his engineering job, lays flowers on his wife's grave, and trains for another long adventure-this time, solo. It is important to have plans, he says. He is running out of time and against all odds and Doctor's recommendations, he is determined to have one last adventure before the end. His love and dedication for traveling are stronger than any medical diagnosis. Amid the windswept plains, canyons, dirt roads and high mountain passes of the Argentinean Andes, Pueyrredon repeats the final journey he made with his departed friend, bicycling alone for five days to a viaduct at 14,000 feet, guided by his memory. The film's most moving scene will challenge the dry eyes of even the sternest stoic. "I don't feel they are gone," Pueyrredon says of his wife and friend.

"What we realize through this film is that our most profound journeys can happen at any time in life - and perhaps the later we take them, the more rich and meaningful they become. And, no matter the challenges we face in life, there is always joy to be found - even in the most fleeting moments."


* Rebecca Martin, jury member

title: Love at First Sight
description: An elaborate scheme caused Lisa Shaw to lose her virginity, family, and loved ones. Malicious lies and devious schemes made her the public enemy of the entertainment industry...

title: Bishop Ronald C. Hill's All In: The Documentary
description: Ron Hill's "All In" documentary is about a man who was reared in a challenging time. However, no matter what he did from Sports, Sin, to Salvation He was "All In!" We will take you on a journey to discover the scores he made during his game of life.

title: Love of the Divine Tree
description: The leader of the Xishan Sect seals a demonic spring to protect people, but is attacked. Her disciple learns the truth, helps her reincarnate, and falls in love with her new self as they defeat the demonic cultivator seeking the spring.

title: Love at 0°C
description: Sun Yixin is an aspiring fashion designer but is unable to find a job. Her friend Xiaoling aspires to enter high society and marry a rich man's son and often drags Yixin along to high-class parties. Yixin's mother forces her to help out with her cleaning business. She is forced to do the cleaning herself when she discovers that the business is in debt due to her mother's negligence. Her first assignment was to clean the house of Hu Zhitao, an irascible old man who looks after his grandson with an iron hand and happens to be Guobin's father. Yixin and Hu Guobin were classmates at design school and share a love-hate relationship. She Weixiang and his partner Victor run a dinner dress rental and auction business. Although from a wealthy background, he is estranged from his father and detests him for having a mistress. By chance, Yixin bumps into them and her fashion expertise comes into handy. A love triangle inevitably forms.

title: Married The Richest Man After Being Dumped
description: Cassie finds out that her sister Lisa is having an affair with her richest boyfriend, Eric. Butinstead of feeling ashamed, she says Cassie and her mother Helen are a drag because theywere born poor. The injured mother nearly died of a heart attack. In order to get back at hersister and her ex-boyfriend, Cassie decides to marry the richest man, Johnny Brisson, andbecomes her sister's mother-in-law and ex-stepmother.

title: [ENG DUB] The Unwanted Cinderella's Transformation
description: Estella Graham, who was pure and kind, was discovered not to be the biological daughter of the Graham family. All of a sudden, Estella became a fake daughter who everyone shouted for. Not only did his childhood sweetheart, fiancé Hanrick Scott, get involved with the real daughter Marina Graham, but he was also drugged by Hanrick and had a one night stand with Elijah Scott, the chief executive of the Scott family. After waking up, Estella Graham knew everything and resolutely left the Graham family to seek refuge with his best friend. What she didn't know was that Elijah could only relieve his mania on Estella, so he kept investigating her who had a one night stand with him at that time...

title: Harihar Bhakti
description: Mythologial story of a King Banasur, who was a great devotee of Lord Shiva. Banasur grew great and powerful with a boon from Lord Shiva that he could not be defeated by any outside enemy, and conquered the neighboring kingdoms and torturing his Vaishnav subjects and converting them forcibly into Shaivites. Amidst this torturous rule, the marriage problem of his daughter Usha beset Banasur and the fear of his daughter marrying a Vaishnav instilled in him through a premonition in his dream, which subsequently compelled him to take steps of imprisoning his daughter in a place so that she would give up the idea of marriage. By a twist of fate, while Usha tries to find a solution for a peaceful rule of her dreaded father she falls in love with Anirudh, the grandson of Lord Krishna who appears to her in a dream. Usha's friend Chitralekha helps her to fulfill the dream, by secretly kidnapping the prince Anirudh from Dwaraka while he is asleep, and bringing him to her palace along with his cot. The great Narad Muni officiated the wedding. On learning the marriage of his daughter, Banasur gets very wild and rushes to the palace and fights with Anurudh and binds him with his "Sarpa Astra". In the meanwhile the Vaishnav subjects leave the town and proceed to Dwaraka and narrate the whole atrocities committed on them by Banasur. The news of kidnapping of Anirudh, his marriage with Usha and the subsequent binding of the Sarpa Astra on him enrages Lord Krishna and he decides to wage war with Banasur. Narad, by his machinations on both sides, gets the two armies of Lord Krishna and Lord Shiva ready to battle each other.

title: O Contador de Histórias (The Story Teller)
description: The saga of a family coming from a poor part of northeast Brazil, moving to the Amazon and then the rest of the world, through poverty, drama and grandiose story telling.

title: The All-devouring Whale: Homecoming
description: Reborn after a deadly betrayal, Fan Lingxiao fights to uncover the truth and restore his shattered sect.

title: Law Above Blood: Justice, Served by Me
description: The richest man in Hethor suddenly approaches Olivia Parker and reveals that she is his long-lost daughter. But the moment she returns, her brother presses an offer to buy her shares, while the fake heiress plots against her. Olivia fights back with sharp legal skills and fists to match. She comes back not for luxury, but to uncover the truth behind her mother’s murder and put every guilty member of her cold-blooded family behind bars.

title: L'Héritier Secret du Prince Elfe ( Doublé )
description: Six ans après une nuit de passion avec un inconnu masqué, Manon se présente au palais des Elfes de sang, accompagnée de son fils, sans savoir que le prince Xavier est le père du garçon. Mais entre quiproquos et un antique pacte de mariage du Clan du Dragon, leur destin semble vouloir les séparer.

title: Born to Rule, Not to Obey
description: When Ava Sinclair invites her classmates to her home for a birthday celebration, her nemesis, Zoe Harrington, shows up uninvited. Looking around the luxurious estate of Ava's family, arrogance fills Zoe's heart as she criticizes Ava's family photo to satisfy her desire to retaliate against Ava. Upon calling Ava's mother a mistress, she calls Ava and her CEO brother, Owen Sinclair, illegitimate children, humiliating the identities of Ava's entire family.

title: Brutal Bigfoot Encounters: Mutilations and Mutations
description: A team of investigators scour the Arkansas countryside for a missing person, but they soon find the area is infested with bloodthirsty monsters.

title: Itlu Amma
description: On a stormy night, a young boy named Venu gets stabbed. The police are of no help, so his mother, Balasaraswathi, sets out to look for him all by herself.

title: My Calorie Boy
description: Kang Jiawei and Xu Jingjing, along with their group of high school friends, navigate friendship, growth, and self-discovery, experiencing the highs and lows of their unique youth.

title: Struggle for Life
description: Two young boys in a tribe in central Sudan face everyday hardship just trying to survive with the rest of their people.

title: My Pheromones Drove My Four Brothers Crazy
description: Missing since five, Cavendish heir Emmett returns as Julian, an amnesiac student. His four intended Alpha mates fail to recognize him. Jasper bullies him and invites him to a banquet to humiliate him. When his first heat hits, his sabotaged suppressant fails. His pheromones reveal his identity to the brothers but send every Alpha into a frenzy. As the crowd closes in and the brothers enter rut, everything spirals out of control.

title: The Invincible Bodyguard

title: Sweet Teeth
description: Dentist Ai Jing Chu, who also teaches at Donghu University, is known to be the most handsome man at school. University librarian Zeng Li, however, is prejudiced against him because of a little misunderstanding. When Zeng Li's mother forces her to get braces, she tries to avoid Ai Jing Chu at all costs, but eventually still ends up becoming his patient. As the two interact more and more with each other, Zeng Li realizes that Ai Jing Chu is actually a very professional and caring person, and starts to develop feelings for him.

title: The Dangerous Heir（DUBBED）
description: After losing her parents and everything she owns overnight, Kang Seo-yeon spends 15 years plotting revenge as Kim Yoo-jin, the adopted daughter of her enemy, Kim Do-hyung. When his son, Lee Jae-hyun, returns home, she draws him in carefully. As their dangerous game turns into real feelings, Jae-hyun falls deeply in love and even opposes Do-hyung for her sake. But when the truth comes out, he realizes he has been a pawn all along. Will he stand by Yoo-jin or turn against her?

title: Rising with the Wind [Hindi]

title: You Took My S-Rank Talent, I Got a System
description: Charles awakened the system after being stripped of his talent by his foster father. His foster dad's son Ryan got his S-Rank talent. Charles was remarkable in contracting an S-Rank Spirit Beast and clearing the trial in the Hunter Tower. He defeated Ryan. By obtaining rare resources, Charles improved his own ability and his beast's growth. To find his parents, he entered another world...

title: Love is Fate [Hindi]
description: After surviving a near-fatal accident, hotel heiress Ma Keai returns home to inherit her father’s hotel empire, only to become entangled in a series of dangerous incidents. With Xia Yuxing by her side, she uncovers a hidden conspiracy threatening both her life and her family’s legacy.

title: Invincible Bodyguard
description: A highly trained fighter goes undercover as a security guard to protect a brilliant scientist who invented "Aura" — a drug that could cure cancer. A ruthless powerful man wants her discovery at any cost. But as the mission unfolds, the fighter discovers a terrifying truth - his enemy's father destroyed his family years ago. This is no longer just a mission. It's personal.

title: Love of Nirvana
description: A former lord kidnaps a survivor to uncover his family's secrets. His plan is disrupted when he meets a woman aided by an ally. They develop feelings and, with help, fight to overthrow a corrupt emperor.

title: [ENG DUB] Unexpected Billionaire: Accidental Marriage
description: Mia Toll was working in a design company, but her leader suddenly fired her because Mia's malicious stepmother schemed behind this. She accidentally met Yusuf and decided to have a blind date with him. Soon they got married. It turns out that Yusuf was the CEO of a famous group and a billionaire. What will happen between them?

title: War of the Divine Blood
description: A child born with both divine and demonic blood is secretly sent to Nanjing and raised by a group of fallen heroes. Believed to be powerless, Jinwoo grows up surrounded by love and sacrifice. When a ruthless ruler orders the extermination of all Nanjing's people, Jinwoo must uncover the truth of his origin, awaken his extraordinary strength, and fight to save his home from destruction.

title: I Belonged to Your World [Hindi]
description: Qi Shuo, Qi Yue's future son, warns her of an unhappy marriage. Determined to rewrite her fate, he transforms her to enroll at Lu Xiao's university, where she cleverly pursues him until winning his heart.

title: Married in Disguise
description: Gigi Jaffe hides her identity as the CEO of Minley Corp and goes for a blind date in hopes to find a good man, while Leo Burke is the head of Chilton Corp who pretends to be a poor guy because he does not want a gold-digger as his wife. The two of them find each other a great match, not knowing that their respective companies are business partners, and they almost get their own hidden identities exposed multiple times.

title: Golden Dragon Mother’s Rampage
description:
In my past life, I was a pure-blooded white dragon who gave everything to help him seize the throne—only to have that hypocrite  Igon  sever my wings, steal my child, shatter my egg, and summon heavenly thunder to strike me down. With my dying breath, I swore on my blood: if I ever returned, I would make him pay a hundredfold!

I open my eyes to find myself back at the royal consort selection ceremony—the very day he chose my half-sister Jean  instead, and tried to ruin my name with a so-called "divine prophecy." Fine. I sneak straight into the forbidden depths and claim the legendary ancient Golden Dragon, Cedric, as my mate—conceiving the supreme dragon heir!

The scumbag gloats as his egg hatches a golden dragon, taunting me that my black egg could only produce a lowly black dragon. But when my egg cracks open—a rainbow-colored Supreme Saint Dragon emerges, crushing his shadowy black dragon whelp in an instant! With our bet sealed, I raise my blade and sever his wings, ripping off his false golden dragon disguise for all to see—

Wait. The "black dragon" mate I picked up on a whim… is the undisputed pinnacle of all dragonkind?!

"My dear, for the sake of saving dragon bloodline, we'll just have to try a few more times." He chuckles, pulling me closer by the waist.

This rebirth? Totally worth it.

title: Guardians of the Dafeng
description: Follows a young man named Xu Qi An as he works as a night patrol officer in Dafeng City. Xu Qi An must utilize his expertise to solve the crimes and defend the citizens of the city as a result of a string of unexplained incidents.

title: Billionaire's Spoiled Love After Flash Marriage
description: Forced into marriage by her family, Mu Qianxue accidentally marries a beggar on the street. Little did she know, her new husband was Feng Jiucheng, the president of the Feng Corporation who lost his memory in a plane crash. With Mu Qianxue's tender care, Feng Jiucheng's memory gradually returns, revealing the secrets behind the crash! Dive into this thrilling romance to see how Mu Qianxue's whirlwind marriage leads to her billionaire husband's lavish love and the uncovering of hidden truths.

title: Peerless Martial Spirit [English]
description: In a mystical realm, an outcast awakens a dragon bloodline, transforming him into a formidable cultivator. Attracting admirers, he pursues the pinnacle of martial prowess.

title: My Fake Husband Is the Dragon King
description: Three years ago, Elena was drugged by her sister Helena and had a wild night with Dragon King Derek, later laying two dragon eggs. Helena stole the eggs to impersonate Derek's mate, while Elena was exiled. Years later, Derek travels south with the unhatched eggs and meets Elena. Her blood triggers their birth, bonding the family. They fake-marry, and romance blooms. Helena's dark plots fail when the dragon powers confirm Elena as the real mother, bringing peace at last.

title: Mon gigolo est le boss !(doublage)
description: La famille Durand retrouve sa vraie fille et chasse Mélanie Durand de la maison. Son mari nominal est parti à l'étranger avec sa maîtresse. Seule au monde, Mélanie se complaît chaque jour dans les bras de son gigolo Aurélien Simon. Lorsque son mari annonce son retour, Mélanie rompt avec Aurélien. C'est alors qu'elle découvre qu'Aurélien est en fait le célèbre Prince.

title: The Legendary Mage Returns
description: Three years ago, transcendent S-rank legend Aiden fell, cursed and amnesiac by the Devouring Abyss. Radiant Academy prodigy Irene risked her life with Soul Link to wake his memories and power. Wielding a simple training staff, he beats rivals from five academies and exposes traitor Lance. He and Irene unleash Ice-Thunder Twin Soul Resonance to slay the Abyss Nine-Headed Demon God and Maeve. At last, he crowns Irene with the S-rank Guardian Sacred Crown.

title: Fascination
description: A web of manipulation sparks an irresistible, forbidden romance that erupts beyond control.

title: In Love, In Silence
description:
"Queenie James lost her parents at a young age and was left to suffer under the cruel hands of her uncle and aunt. She managed to get into university—only to face new hardships due to her poverty and inability to speak.A chance encounter brought Harrison Fletcher, a cold and powerful CEO, into her life. Moved by her resilience, he stepped into her world and offered her a way out.
In Harrison's world, Queenie found something she had never dared to hope for: care, respect, and a family that accepted her for who she was. As their bond deepened, she learned that even those without a voice could be heard—when someone truly listened."

title: David F.
description: Black is scientifically the absence of color, but not all who see it are color-blind. David F. weaves three stories that take a look at the lineage of African-Americans in the Philippines--from American soldiers in the Philippine-American war to the Amerasians in the former Clark Air Base, and how we Pinoys take to them. It begins with the Philippine-American war in the early 1900's when two Filipinos want to get the reward money for capturing David Fagen, the African-American soldier who deserted the U.S. army to join the Filipino revolutionaries against the new colonizers. Another thread of the film looks at the life of a Filipina during the Japanese occupation before the return of General Douglas MacArthur in 1944 who gives birth to a baby that turns out to be black-skinned. Finally, in contemporary times, a black gay impersonator in a comedy bar, whose father is an African-American soldier based in Clark Air Base in Angeles City, tries to find his father who abandoned him. In the course of history, the "F" in "David F." may spell different levels of discrimination. But would we also admit that we Filipinos are bigots ourselves?

description: Erng was Mew's first love. After she was disappeared one day suddenly, he was not able to move on. Ten years later, just when he was ready for the idea of moving on, his first love has returned. However, there is something quite different about her - something was unworldly.

title: Cowboy G-Men
description: Pat Gallagher and his sidekick Stoney Crockett are Secret Service agents in the Old West, dispatched by the government to investigate crimes threatening the young nation.

title: Are You G?
description: A lifestyle talk show that sparks bold conversations and shared experiences, inviting guests and viewers to say yes to life's unfolding moments.

title: Mythos Ot(h)ello
description: Kaum einer hatte wohl noch mit einem solchen Spätwerk von Giuseppe Verdi gerechnet: Als 1887 die Uraufführung von "Otello" stattfand, hatte er 16 Jahre lang keine Oper mehr geschrieben. Warum hatte Verdi sich ausgerechnet von der Geschichte des schwarzen Generals, der Opfer einer Intrige wird und aus falscher Eifersucht seine Frau ermordet, angezogen gefühlt? Shakespeares Dramenvorlage "Othello" ist sicherlich eines der größten Meisterwerke der Theatergeschichte. Aus heutiger Sicht ist es spannend und erhellend zu ergründen, was die beiden Meister ihres Fachs an einem schwarzen Titelhelden faszinierte und wie sie mit ihm umgehen. Welche Rolle spielten Schwarze in der Welt, in der Shakespeare und Verdi lebten? Welchen Einfluss hatte der Hintergrund des Kolonialzeitalters, das in England in Shakespeares Epoche und in Italien zu Verdis Lebzeiten anbrach? Wie wurde dieser erste schwarze Titelheld der Theater- und Operngeschichte seither dargestellt und was sagt das über die Vorstellung "Weißer" von "Schwarzen" aus? Diesen Fragen widmet sich die ARTE-Dokumentation "Mythos Ot(h)ello". Jonas Kaufmann und Antonio Pappano führen durch Verdis geniales Musikdrama. Experten und Expertinnen beleuchten die historischen Hintergründe sowohl der Oper wie Shakespeares Stücks. Fußballlegende Jimmy Hartwig, der nach seiner Sportlerlaufbahn eine Karriere als Schauspieler machte, erzählt, was Ot(h)ello mit seiner Rassismuserfahrung und seinem Leben zu tun hat.

title: H-H
description: The Rhodiacéta in Besancon is a former Rhône-Poulenc-owned textile factory. It became an emblematic site following the 1967 workers' movement and films made by the Medvedkine groups. In 2015, the city of Besancon decided to redevelop the site, which had fallen into ruin. When it came to the demolition of existing buildings, questions were raised about the possibility of retaining parts of them, but what to save, and how? During the redevelopment memories associated with the site were transformed and reincarnated; for example, you will be able to see the typography of a logo reflected in the lines of the new building. H-H by Chloé Malcotti focuses on the actions involved in their process, their meanings, their policies and the new relationships with the world which result.

title: H4Z4RD

title: H: Murmur
description: Serial killer Shin-Hyun gives himself up to police and confesses to committing a series of particularly horrifying murders of exclusively female victims. He is imprisoned and awaiting the death sentence but the killings continue, with the same characteristics of the Shin-Hyun serial killings. The case is re-opened when two more bodies are discovered, both pregnant women; one found in the city's landfill site and the other was horrifically murdered on a public bus. Detective Mi Yun (Yum Jung-Ah) and her newly-appointed partner Detective Kang (Ji Jin-Hee) are assigned to the case. Mi Yun and Kang have difficulty working with each other; their personalities and working methods constantly clash. Detective Kang goes about his new job buoyantly and enthusiastically. He follows a new suspect, Huh, and eventually catches him in the act of brutally murdering a woman in a crowded techno bar. Huh is taken into custody after Kang shoots and wounds him at the crime scene. Once again, the case seems to be solved with this spectacular arrest--yet the murders continue in copy-cat style. The police desperately hunt for new leads. They start an in-depth investigation of a Doctor Chu, who is Shin-Hyun's psychiatrist, but progress is frustrated when Dr Chu becomes a victim of the copy-cat killings herself. The murdered psychiatrist's former boyfriend, a fanatical character named Choi, quickly becomes the prime suspect. All the pieces are finally starting to fit together, and the case seems almost resolved. But all efforts are suddenly frustrated once again, when Choi takes his own life--but still, the killings continue. The case gets more complicated when even the police themselves appear to become suspects in the murders. In unraveling this mystery, everyone involved is pushed to the limits of human understanding.

title: I'm Glad I Could Keep Running
description: The story centers on Minato, who goes to an anime event that has a voice acting recital with a friend. The series follows the trials and tribulations of those who aim to become voice actors.

title: Ma-i peul-le-i-seu
description: An intimate 7-year journey of a family struggling to overcome past wounds of reverse migration (from Canada to Korea) begins when the director's little sister decides to be an un-wed single mom. The little sister decides to raise the child in Canada as she never felt welcome in her parent's homeland, South Korea. The lives of parents, intertwined with Korea's modern history is revealed, while family members try to come together to face the challenges of raising a new baby outside of the traditional family form. What starts out as the director's personal journey of re-discovering the lives of family members and self, evolves into broader themes of cultural differences, identity, and belonging.

title: What I Have I Hold, Gentlemen...!
description: In a prefabricated house at the housing estate there live the Nováks and the Bartáceks. The members of both families lack spiritual values altogether. The highest life aim is to gain as much money as possible and to show the others that they are more "posh". Renek, son of the Nováks, a taxi-driver who drives only foreigners with the western currency invents for his parents a plan: he founds a club of the Nováks and every Novák is to send an enrollment fee of 5 crowns to the address of the grandfather of the Nováks who lives in a small house. During the action they move him to their flat under the pretext of cleaning up.

title: Neighborhood Witch J
description: A star in the world of internet content creation, Seo Je Yi (Park Ji Yeon) has made quite a name for herself as a beauty expert. A smooth talker who isn't afraid to tell it like it is, Je Yi has amassed an impressive following since the start of her career and the numbers just keep rising. With so many dedicated followers, companies are beginning to take notice of Je Yi, including Lee Woo Bin (Lee Tae Sun), the CEO of a cosmetics start-up company whose products Je Yi has acknowledged on more than one occasion. A highly intelligent man, Lee Woo Bin knows what it takes to run a company well but when it comes to social interaction, he has absolutely no idea what he's doing. Encouraged by Je Yi's glowing reviews of his products, Woo Bin has tried, on more than one occasion, to get better acquainted with the rising star, but every attempt he has made so far has failed miserably. Meanwhile, Lee Tae Kyung (Jang Eui Soo), the director of MCN, a company specializing in managing content creators, has taken a sudden interest in Je Yi and he's determined to win her over. With so many roads now opening before her, Je Yi must decide which path will lead to both her success and happiness. But which path should she choose when her head tells her to go one way and her heart tells her to go another? The first selection for the 2020 pilot division of the Broadcasting Content Production Support Project, "Next Door Witch J" is a 2021 Viki Original romantic drama directed by Yoon Ji Hoon.

description: Czech patriots are planning to rescue their colleague from the torture chambers of the Gestapo. After staging a wedding, they gather in one of the local pubs. The operation ends successfully, and the brave soldier again manages to fool the Nazis.

description: Ki-woo, who hasn’t been able to tell his mother about his marriage problems and has been bouncing from one contract job interview to another due to past rumors at school, meets “Lee Hyun-jae”—whose face is badly bruised—at Nakwon High School. Everyone tells Ki-woo, who is the son of the school’s chairman, “Don’t worry about him.” But Ki-woo begins to find Hyun-jae intriguing. He intentionally starts chatting with Ki-woo, and…

title: The Flute of Love [Starr. Chioma Chukwuka & Daniel K Daniel]
description: When the gods decree, who are we, mere mortals; to question the will of the gods. The movie flute of love possesses an unusual kind of epic story; a type done with rich vusuals, impassioned functionality aimed for a deeper impact on the targeted audience.In the movie, three great men have been nominated by the gods to perform the most challenging and unbelievable task which qualifies each of them to be selected as the royal groom for the beautiful amiable princess of the bride. As challenging and tough as their task appears, one man must eventually conquer against all odds. This masterpiece is indeed an overwhelming tale of surprise, discovery and reawakening. The gods do not make make errors and all destinies fall into their divine plan.

description: The city of Los Angeles is heavily divided into two zones: rich and poor. Crime is at its peak in the poor zone. Ex-NAVY SEAL Kyle H. After stumbling into the poor zone Kyle soon finds himself killing all those who cause crime in the poor zone, this becomes Kyle's new source for adrenalin and purpose, with Kyle killing, gang members, rapists and drug dealers, he of course makes enemies, including the corrupt cops and the notorious drug and crime lord, cocaine n' coco pops.

title: Big Daddy
description: A visitor to the Everglades swamps in Florida encounters and falls in love with an uneducated girl. But he finds competition for her affections from the unlikely and mysterious A. Beauregard Lincoln. He also discovers danger from nature in the form of vicious alligators and from the mystical in the form of a voodoo witch doctor.

title: Tale of A-rang
description: Lee Eun Oh, a noble's son, arrives at a small village in search of his missing mother. There, Arang, the ghost of a young woman that lost her memories of her past life, asks him to help her to figure out her identity and how she died.

title: Alibhabha
description: The city is being shaken by many heart-stopping crimes taking place at different places. Young women are being molested and killed with alarming frequency. Velu (Kreshna) helps his father Subramaniam (Prakash Raj) in stealing. Being seasoned thieves, they rob everything right from pins to cars. A spate of young women are murdered, and these developments rock the city. Thiagarajan (Azhagam Perumal), a tough cop, investigates the case. However, differences of opinions crop between the Police Commissioner (Biju Menon) and Thiagarajan. One day, Velu saves the commissioner from a meeting in order to steal the commissioner car's audio player, and gets acquainted with him. Velu then begins to fall for Janani (Janani), who works in a bank. One day, when Velu withdraws money, he is shocked to find the balance amount to be Rs. 5 Lakhs. It suddenly swells to Rs. 30 Lakhs and reaches Rs. 70 Lakhs. That is when Subramaniam realizes that this is no mere coincidence. Someone was smartly using them as a pawn to cover up for other more serious activities. They were being used as the 'third man', a pretty common term in criminal parlance. Before they realize, all of them are caught in the web that was laid out. Who laid it out, how and why and do they eventually come out of it forms Alibaba. Subramaniam comes to Velu's rescue and manages to find the reason behind it. When the family begins to find out the reason behind this act, it results in bloodshed and gore, eventually ending up in Velu coming across the killers of young women in the city.

title: Sweet Blood
description: On the night of a blue moon lunar eclipse that happens once in ten years, the portal between the vampire world, where drinking human blood is forbidden, and the human world opens. Lucifer, a vampire prince who desperately craves human blood, descends into the human world. Min U, a university student in his early twenties, moves to the city from the countryside. He works tirelessly, day and night, to save up for tuition while also studying hard. However, Min U contracts a rare disease that puts his life at risk whenever he bleeds. One day, Min U becomes a victim of a hit-and-run accident, bleeding and finding himself in a life-threatening situation. Lucifer, drawn by the scent of blood, attacks Min U. However, something strange happens: Lucifer collapses, and Min U miraculously survives, unharmed.

title: R.E.M. Live
description: R.E.M. Live is a live album from R.E.M., recorded at the Point Theatre, Dublin, on February 26 and 27, 2005, the closing nights of the winter European leg of the Around the World Tour in support of their thirteenth studio album Around the Sun released in late 2004. It was released in the United Kingdom on October 15, 2007 and in the United States a day later as a two-Compact Disc audio set and a DVD, then released in February 2008 as a triple vinyl set. The performance was filmed by Blue Leach the same director of Depeche Mode DVD "Touring the Angel: Live in Milan". R.E.M. Live features rare performances of "I Took Your Name" from 1994's Monster and "Ascent of Man" from Around The Sun as well as the previously unreleased "I'm Gonna DJ." A studio version of that song would later appear on the band's 2008 effort, Accelerate.

title: Class N Session
description: Casting "Class N Session," a new series. Synopsis: Meet Kaitlyn Johnson (Jassy Marie), an intelligent, teenage African American sophomore girl with a quick sarcastic wit to match, which fits her future aspiration of becoming a criminal lawyer, which stems from watching marathon episodes of "Law and Order" on cable with her mother. Kaitlyn's best friend since pre-K is Vanessa Hardison (Alexis Dees), who's also an intelligent African American sophomore girl who decided her own future aspiration of becoming a celebrity lawyer after watching old footage of Johnny Cochran's performance in the O. J. Simpson trial. She also has a similar sarcastic quick wit. For years, these girls used the same facial expression to communicate with each other when someone said something idiotic. Their favorite facial expression is named "The Garfield Look," which matches the bored facial expression of Garfield the Cat. Both young ladies attend Ladera Heights High School, along with their new friends, Lisa Kim (their eccentric but very smart friend), Caleb Stevens and Louis Taylor (two of the brightest class clowns you ever want to meet; think Romeo and Bullethead from "The Steve Harvey Show," with intelligence), and Cissy Bailey (their sassy Caucasian friend who was raised in the hood). This prestigious secondary school is run by Principal Bryant, a very thorough, no-nonsense principal who's fair but firm and also has an annoying tendency to pop up unannounced on her students anywhere. Principal Bryant doesn't tolerate disruptive students who waste their time in high school; she's especially strict on rules about the students not sassing their parents. Every high school student has a favorite teacher; Mr. Reevis is that favorite teacher, who uses wit to teach his U.S. Government class. With Kaitlyn and Vanessa's aspirations of becoming a criminal lawyer and celebrity lawyer, can they survive through all the trials and tribulations high school has in store for them? Watch "Class N Session" to find out.

description: A scaffolding builder loses his job and starts as a temporary worker at the funfair. There he is seduced by a showman into making a career as a fairground boxer - and hopes to fulfill a long-awaited dream for his daughter.

title: Flying Saucer Rock 'N' Roll
description: 1957. A happy time of big fins, Rockabilly music and innocent teen love... Until the Martians come. In one night three teenagers have their world turned upside down when threatened by Zombie Beatniks, hopped up on space weed and bent on harvesting earth women for Martian demise. Only our square hero Johnny Keen, with help from his beatnik friend, Maynard, can defeat them. But can Johnny become "cool" enough in time to save his girl, Susie, and the day?! Drenched in Rockabilly music and greaser culture, "Flying Saucer Rock N Roll" is one swell ride from start to finish.

title: Get Krack!n
description: Having conquered the cutthroat world of satirical cooking shows Kate McLennan and Kate McCartney take a Sassy Swipe at the bright, chirpy world of morning TV with their signature brand of social awkwardness and unprofessionalism.

title: Rock 'n Tokyo
description: Tokyo proposes several different levels of reality. You can find anything you can imagine there and at the same time get a new surprise at every corner. I chose to portray this amazing city through rock 'n roll music. The Japanese love and understand rock, a kind of music and a way of life they discovered during the American occupation, after World War II. Even if Japanese society still preaches uniformity and order, there is an important underground world, where people live more freely. This is the Tokyo I show in my movie. We follow 4 rock bands : Guitar Wolf, 3 good looking guys wearing black leather and sunglasses, a singer/guitar player with a devilish presence, a garage rock that is among the most intense and loudest ever heard and surprisingly- a contract with a big record company ; The 5678s, rock-a-billy queens with a wild 50s elegance who conquered the world with a memorable scene in Quentin Tarantino's Kill Bill ; the Jet Boys, led by an extreme, crazy, border-less and exhibitionist singer/guitar player ; Nine, young guys who believe in success by music - when I first met them, they played in front of Shinjuku station as if it was the last concert of their lives. The movie shows their music, but also their way of living, their style-totally faithful to rock ,n roll- and their wanderings all around the incredible city that is Tokyo.

title: Stories N' Steel
description: A fresh take on automotive reality TV, each episode features builders, collectors and craftsmen telling their stories through lively discussion and visual examples of their passions.

title: Up 'n' Under
description: The Cobblers Arms have been the best and most feared Amateur Rugby League team for the past ten years. Ex-pro Arthur bets their boss that he could train a bunch of deadbeats to defeat them in a local rugby sevens tournament. But to do so he must first get them into shape with the help of the very attractive Hazel Scott.

title: The Great North S1-S5
description: The adventures of a single dad and his weird Alaskan family.

title: O
description: An update of Shakespeare's 'Othello' with a young cast, set in an upper class prep school, and centered around basketball player Odin.

title: O+
description: In the 90's, two successful Dominicans living in Buenos Aires face rejection, prejudice and ignorance for being HIV positive.

title: O Chinadaana
description: Ramya, a young girl, loses faith in love after her childhood crush, Rajesh, relocates elsewhere. However, her sister, Divya, and Srinivasa plot to make her fall in love again.

title: O Eu Quebrado o Encontrou Novamente
description: Sofrendo bullying e forçada a terminar com seu primeiro amor, ela entrou em uma espiral de dor, acabando em um hospital psiquiátrico onde deu à luz uma filha. Cinco anos depois, lutando para sobreviver com sua filha, as pessoas que a atormentaram voltam. Após deixá-la, seu primeiro amor se tornou um advogado renomado. Quando se encontram acidentalmente na rua, será que podem reacender o amor perdido?

title: O ergenis
description: Theodoris Dimitriadis is an average happily married Greek man who works as a bank clerk in the late '90s in Athens. After his wife's mysterious disappearance he soon finds out that she has become a courtesan for rich foreigners.

title: 49-o
description: Goundamani, the 'counter king, makes a comeback this time with a lead role dealing with the nuances of local politics

title: Day-O
description: Grace Connors is facing a major load of family and business problems that she doesn't think she can handle. Like a touch of magic, unexpected help returns to her after many years of absence: her childhood imaginary friend Dayo comes back to help her cope with any and every possible obstacle--but also causes new problems, which make amusing situations.

title: Entre o Gelo e o Amor
description: Lena, uma talentosa patinadora artística, muda-se para Nova Rosa e descobre que seu namorado virtual é o capitão do time de hóquei de seu irmão. Entre identidades reveladas, ciúmes e a pressão da fama, ela precisa escolher entre o amor e o sonho de brilhar novamente nas pistas de gelo.

title: O... Çocuklari
description: Turkey is under the yoke of the military regime. Unbelievable events will develop in the axis of the house of the custodian mother, who takes care of the children of prostitutes.

title: #O Premave
description: Anjali falls in love with Rahul with the assumption that he is a millionaire. Soon when she realizes that she has been mistaken she dumps him.

title: Henry O!
description: Spanish-language color commentator for the Tampa Bay Devil Ray's Enrique "Henry" Oliu does the impossible - he calls a game he's never seen.

title: O modistros
description: The relationship between a doctor and his wife gets broken after he came home late last night. Meanwhile, he has to pretend to be a dressmaker because of a misunderstanding between him and the furious fiancé of an old girlfriend he met.

title: O Coro
description: A documentary series that aims to introduce four Portuguese choirs in their encounter with a conductor/musical director, who will guide us to each of the groups, their choir members and their stories, and who will work on their repertoire for a public and apotheotic presentation.

title: O Carteiro
description: Victor (Candé Faria) is a postman in the interior of Rio Grande do Sul and has the habit of opening the correspondence of the residents. In love with a new resident of the city, the young Marli (Ana Carolina Machado), who exchanges letters with her boyfriend, Victor begins to control the letters between the couple and ends up interfering in the couple's relationship.

title: O'
description: O 'is a soap opera telling the adventures of a family of millionaires, the O'Hara, who own a bottled water company.

title: O Liberdade
description: The documentary talk about a magic place, the heart of the bohemian in Pelotas, southern Brazil. The Samba, Choro, and all the popular culture.

title: O zitianos
description: In the village of Nykteremi (Thessalian plain), a few years after it was annexed to Greece, a cunning professional beggar, Jiritokostas, succeeds in exploiting the misery, fears, prejudices and ignorance of the Thessalonians.

title: O tetraperatos
description: A vibrant cafe owner struggles to attract the girl of his dreams. Who knows, with a bit of luck and sharp wits, life can sometimes be a bed of roses.

title: O Coco, A Roda, O Pnêu e O Farol
description: A documentary about the "roda de coco" in Amaro Branco, place where, for more than 100 years, the people maintain the tradition of this contagious rhythm of the Brazilian northeast. The film shows the characters, the tradition and the wealth of this northeastern dance. More than that, it invites you to the middle of the "roda de coco".

title: O' Romeo
description: In post-independence Mumbai, the underworld rises amidst a changing city. This gritty tale explores the criminal landscape of a bygone era, weaving through the streets and shadows of India's bustling metropolis.

title: O Maria
description: Maria is a single woman of forty plus, living alone with her mother (Sulbha Arya), running a quiet business of putting up tourists in her house by the sea and a small restaurant. She has the good fortune of owning a land and a house in a prime spot by the sea which is eyed by developers. Philomena (Meenacshi Martins) needs to sell their ancestral property which is at a prime location to a Gujarati property developer Jiten Shah 'Jitubhai' (Tiku Talsania). For this, Philomena's elder son Jack (Aryan Khedekar) teams up with his mother to seek Maria's approval as her brother John (tiatrist Roseferns) has already signed an agreement to this effect. Mike (Cory Goldberg), an American staying as a guest with Maria, also gets dragged into the issue. Cory Goldberg had earlier played the role of a tourist in the Incredible India ad campaign.[1] Ruzar (tiatrist John D'Silva) plays the sacristan who gets the villages together.

title: Jhong at Sarina, sanib-pwersa sa pag-SAMPLE
description:
Bugtong-bugtong, may korona ang hari, may kandila ang cake. Birthday ng Sample King kaya ang buong "It's Showtime" stage ay na-shake. Kasama ang unica hija na si Sarina, ipinagdiwang ni Jhong Hilario ang kaarawan niya.

Bago magsimula ang Miss Q and A segment, it's time para sa inaabangan din na kumustahan at chikahan ng trio nina Vhong Navarro, Vice Ganda, at Jhong Hilario. Mula sa puksaan ng kasuotan hanggang sa asaran ng edad, lahat na 'ata napag-usapan ng magkakaibigan.

Samantala, mga dalubhasa sa pagtalak sina Miss Q&A candidates Dhey Pascual Abital, Beshie, at Erwina Tirambulo. Kung sa nakaraang episode ay nagpakilala ang mga kandidata at hosts with their love status, ngayon naman ay pabonggahan sila ng intro borrowing the acronyms of executive agencies sa Pilipinas.

DOJ, as in Diretso ang Opinyon, Jaw-dropping ang perfromances ng mga kandidata sa pagsagot sa pageant questions. Sina Dhey at Beshie ang umabante sa Wit Lang round.

Bumoses si Dhey tungkol sa pagbabayad ng buwis at epekto ng korapsyon as she answered the question, "Kung kinain ka na ng sistema, may nakuha ba silang sustansya?" It's better to give than to receive naman ang talak ni Beshie sa tanong na, "Kung binabalot ka ng kalungkutan pwede ka bang iregalo?"

Hindi 'to kuwentong barbero. Totoong nag-enjoy sa Laro Laro Pick ang mga masisipag na barberong swabe ang dating. Time out muna sa paggamit ng gunting, sa pagsayaw at pagsagot muna nila ipapakita ang galing.

Enjoy ang hosts sa kuwentuhan kay Jun, ang loving hubby at daddy, na pangarap mapagpatapos ang anak sa kolehiyo. Dahil sa pangarap ni Jun, nakaramdamn ng lungkot si Vice Ganda. Naisip niyang sa Pilipinas, itinuturing na "pangarap" ang diploma, pero kung tutuusin ito ay "basic need na dapat naibibigay sa lahat ng mga bata.

Give na give ang players sa mga challenges sa game arena, hanggang sa may isang natira, si John. May pabaon na swerte ang kanyang buntis na misis. Nakapag-uwi si John ng P40,000 matapos tanggapin ang offer. Nanghinayang nga lang si John dahil alam niya ang sagot sa POT question. Kaya dinagdagan ni Vice ng P10,000 ang papremyo ng barbero.

title: It's Showtime
description:
Dedma sa ex na kumakatok at may pasalubong na paulit-ulit na pasakit. But, hello sa grupong nagbabalik sa "It's Showtime" entablado para pagandahin ang araw n'yo. Napaindak ang buong nation sa performance at taas ng energy ng P-Pop group VXON.

Dazzling sa pagrampa sina Miss Q and A Resbakulawan candidates Andrea Jane Peralta, Jers Sabado, at Mama Dhel. Dahil Resbakulawan, diretso nang sumalang ang tatlo sa Wit Lang. Pagkatapos, sina Andrea at Jers ang umabante sa BEKLAMATION.

Na-impress si hurado Nicole Cordoves, pero aminadong nakulangan nang kaunti sa 'chukchak' ng dalawang ladies. Kaya para iwas-bitin, pati si Vice Ganda ay tumalak na rin! Sa huli, itinanghal na Miss Q and A Reyna Talak-Era Resbakulawan daily winner si Andrea.

Hindi na kailangan pang tumama sa lotto para masabing lucky sa araw na 'to! Dahil swerte agad ang lumapit sa mga taga-San Isidro, Cainta Rizal na bumida sa Laro Laro Pick game arena sa "It's Showtime."

Walang mapapagod kakatawa sa mga challenges sa game arena. Sa paboritong Act-Song portion sa You Gotta Lyric round, time-out muna sa kilig scenes sina Brent Manalo at Jackie Gonzaga dahil magkapatid muna sila sa isang eksena ng family drama.

Hindi naman horror story ang pagsali ni player Pao. Dahil matapos ma-eliminate, nabunot ang pangalan niya upang maglaro sa jackpot round dahil bigo ang mga naunang players na ma-secure ang spot.

Ramdam ni Vice Ganda ang matinding pangangailangan ni Pao, isang siomai vendor na nag-iipon para sa kanyang operasyon sa mata dahil sa kondisyon na keratoconus. Ramdam din nito ang puso ng manlalaro. Kaya para bang binigyan niya ito ng lakas ng loob na sugalan ang POT question.

Pigil ang hininga ng Madlang People at lahat ng nasa studio, hanggang sa isinigaw ni Pao ang sagot. Bumuhos ang emosyon at saya nang i-anunsyo ni Vice Ganda na tama ang sagot ni Pao at maiuuwi nito ang P350,000 POT money.

title: Laugh trip! Vice, pinakita kung paano umangkas sa motor!
description:
HuweBEST kantahan ang sumalubong sa Madlang People! Isang pangmalakasang Air Supply performance ang pinerform nina "Tawag Ng Tanghalan" male champions JM Dela Cerna, Christian Tibayan, Riven Umali, JM Yosures, at Yannie Basical.

Magulo man ang usapan paminsan-minsan pero ang talakan ay naitatawid naman. Tamang laro lang sa "Miss Q and A" with candidates Cola Jane, Veena Loca Latak, at Ramona Baluno.

Na-test ang patience ni Vice Ganda dahil sa mga kandidata. Medyo not listening ang mga 'vadeng' kaya si Meme Vice, gulong-gulo sa usapan, pero gayunpaman, hindi mapigil ang halakhakan. Si Ramona, may malaking problema. Hindi siya nakapag-exam sa eskwela dahil daw sa "Miss Q and A," kaya ang sabi ni Meme, ayaw niyang madamay sa kabulastugan ng kandidata.

Hirit ni Meme, bagsak na sa school, 'lotlot' pa sa contest dahil si Ramona ang unang naligwak sa Tumpak Ganern round. Samantala, sa WIT Lang, umikot man nang bahagya pero nakarating naman sa finish line ang chukchak ni Cola sa tanong na, "Naha-heartbroken din ba ang puso ng saging?" Full of confidence rin ang pagtalak ni Veena as she took on the question, "Sino ang magulang ng anak pawis?"

Ang mga taga-Malabon, kumasa sa hamon. Sino kaya ang pinaka-lucky sa Laro Laro Pick game arena ngayon?

Aliw na medyo 'loading' at 'struggle is real' ang kuwentuhan ng hosts with nanay Marita, na tubong-Malabon talaga. Maya-maya pa, si Vice Ganda napagod na. Pero na-touch din siya sa kabutihan ni Marita, na pinaalala sa kan'ya ang lambing ng isang ina.

Chill naman ang chikahan with Jocar, na mula sa pagiging rider ay magsisimula na sa bagong trabaho sa call center. Paano nga ba dapat umangkas sa motor? Si Vice Ganda, may pag-demo! Sa paalog-alog niyang galawan, siguradong ika'y mapapa-LOL!

Ang swerte ay dumapo kay player Mari. Para bang lucky charm niya ang kanyang 'moon' tattoo na simbolo ng 'liwanag sa dilim.' Speaking of tattoos, ni-reveal din ni Vice Ganda ang dalawa sa tattoos niya, while the other hosts shared kung ano ang gusto nilang ipa-tattoo kung may pagkakataon.

title: "P-Pangit!" binara ang pagkanta ni JACKIE! | It's Showtime
description:
It's the first day of school para sa maraming estudyante. Raise your hand kung excited kang bumalik sa classroom suot ang uniporme! Dito sa "It's Showtime," may extra points ang mga bibo. Don't worry dahil exam, kailangan lang pasado ka sa vibe check!

Kapag um-absent sa klase, mag-submit ng Excuse Letter kay ma'am! Si Vice Ganda, parang class adviser ang tanungan kay Vhong Navarro, na um-absent daw dahil sa ubo? Biro ni Meme, may nakarating sa kanyang kuwento. Ang sakit daw ni Vhong, hindi lang basta ubo? Sabi naman ng Mr. Suave, hindi gano'n ka-OA! He's perfectly okay!

Rated P! As in PASADO ang mga P-POP cuties na kasali sa 'Laro Laro Pick' game arena. Present ang WRIVE, 1621, VXON, AJAA, Cloud 7, at YGIG. Kalahati ng mapapanalunan ng lucky player ay ido-donate sa Helping Hands Healing Hearts Ministries.

Dahil P-Pop members ang bisita, kantahan at sayawan ay hindi mawawala. Nagpakitang-gilas sina VXON Sam at Franz, at nagbigay ng advice sa mga aspiring P-Pop stars. Pero kung si Jackie Gonzaga ang mag-o-audition, biro ni Meme, hindi papasa dahil P-Pop, as in P-Pangit ang boses ni Jackie. Aray naman, Meme!

Umaray rin si Vice Ganda nang mapag-usapan ang role ni Franz sa grupo. Dahan-dahan lang daw sa pagsabi ng 'MAIN VOCAL.' IYKYK. Baka pwedeng 'mang-aawit' na lang?

Pagkatapos ng fun challenges, si um-arrive ang swerte para kay Ishiro ng grupong WRIVE. Sinubukan ni Kim Chiu na kumbinsihin si Ishiro na tanggapin ang Li-Pot offer. Pero, nag-goodbye siya agad sa P20,000 para sa chance na sagutin ang P100,000 POT question.


Kung first day ng school para sa ibang estudyante, first day rin ng Grand Finals ng Tawag Ng Tanghalan Ika-10 Taon.

Sa unang araw ng bakbakan, sina Crisler Aporbo (Region XIII), Timmy Go (CAR), at Charlie Palalisan (Region XII) ang naglaban-laban,

Swabe ang tama ng performance ni Crisler, na binigyan ng bagong tunog ang classic OPM rock song na "Laklak." Dahil papalapit na sa dulo, itinodo na ni Timmy ang talento at ginawang mas masarap ang tunog ng "Saving All My Love For You." Abot-langit naman ang feels sa mapusong pag-awit ni Charlie ng "In The Stars" by Benson Boone.

Para sa Grand Finals, magkakaroon ng Round 2 ang bawat laban. Muling nagharap ang Top 2 scorers of the day, sina Charlie at Crisler. Sa ikalawang round, parehong naging mapuso ang pag-awit ni Charlie ng "Kung Wala Ka" oroginally by Hale, at ni Crisler, na ginawang ballad ang "Di Ko Na Mapipigilan" ng The Sexbomb Girls.

Parehong nagbigay ng matinding laban pero sa araw na ito, isa lang ang pwedeng umangat sa tanghalan. At ito ay si Charlie, na nakakuha ng score ng 93%.

Naisip niyang sa Pilipinas, itinuturing na "pangarap" ang diploma, pero kung tutuusin ito ay "basic need na dapat naibibigay sa lahat ng mga bata.

Give na give ang players sa mga challenges sa game arena, hanggang sa may isang natira, si John. May pabaon na swerte ang kanyang buntis na misis. Nakapag-uwi si John ng P40,000 matapos tanggapin ang offer. Nanghinayang nga lang si John dahil alam niya ang sagot sa POT question. Kaya dinagdagan ni Vice ng P10,000 ang papremyo ng barbero.

title: Bigyan ng P150k 'yan! Tatay Wil, nasagot ang POT question!
description:
Kilig-kiligan ang kantahan sa “It’ Showtime” dahil isang mapusong harana ang hatid ng “Tawag Ng Tanghalan” male champions na sina JM Yosures, Reiven Umali, Christian Tibayan, Yannie Basical, at JM Dela Cerna. Bumisita rin sina “PBB Gen 11” alums Jarren Garcia at Dingdong Bahan para sa maghatid ng good news sa kanilang fans.

Ang mga sagot ng kandidata, siguradong pag-uusapan dahil sa Miss Q and A, intense na naman ang talakan. Bagay sa korona ang pangalan ng mga kandidatang sina Kylie Prinsesa at Princess Vajar. Pero si Candidate #3 na naiiba, Noriel Rodriguez Nabing, feeling daw niya siya ang wicked stepsister.

Itinaas ng mga ‘accla’ ang kanilang bandera as they proudly shared na malaya nilang nagagawa ang mga bagay na limitado sa mga ‘beki’ noon. Ang isang simpleng halimbawa na nabanggit ni Vice Ganda, ang mga beki raw noon ay expected na matutunan ang larong basketball, na kilala bilang sports na panlalaki. Pero ang mga beki ngayon, nakakapili na ng sports na gusto nila. Kaya na-open up ni Meme Vice ang 'unsettled grief' ng mga bakla noon.

Lighthearted kuwentuhan din ang pinagsaluhan ng mga Miss Q and A at "It's Showtime" hosts nang mabanggit ng isang kandidata ang lovelife niya. Binalikan ng "It's Showtime" family ang kanilang mga first love at old-school ways para magpapansin kay crush.

Pwede nang mangarap dahil may kulay at saya ang buhay para sa mga taga-Maricaban, Pasay. Sa Laro Laro Pick game arena, lumaban sila nang sabay-sabay. Pero sa challenges, hindi pwedeng sumablay.

Aliw naman ang aktingan sa Act-Song round na You Gotta Lyric. Si Ion Perez, minulto ni Emilio Daez? At heto pa ang mas matinding plot twist, si Ogie Alcasid humingi ng kiss kay Vhong Navarro!

Ang player na nagtagumpay sa mga challenges hanggang dulo ay walang iba kundi si Marlon. Dahil gusto ni Vice Ganda na madagdagan ang pera ni Marlon, binigyan niya ito ng pagkakataon na sagutin ang POT question.

title: VICE GANDA enjoy sa kulitan with P-POP groups LARO LARO PICK It's Showtime
description:
It's the first day of school para sa maraming estudyante. Raise your hand kung excited kang bumalik sa classroom suot ang uniporme! Dito sa "It's Showtime," may extra points ang mga bibo. Don't worry dahil exam, kailangan lang pasado ka sa vibe check!

Kapag um-absent sa klase, mag-submit ng Excuse Letter kay ma'am! Si Vice Ganda, parang class adviser ang tanungan kay Vhong Navarro, na um-absent daw dahil sa ubo? Biro ni Meme, may nakarating sa kanyang kuwento. Ang sakit daw ni Vhong, hindi lang basta ubo? Sabi naman ng Mr. Suave, hindi gano'n ka-OA! He's perfectly okay!

Rated P! As in PASADO ang mga P-POP cuties na kasali sa 'Laro Laro Pick' game arena. Present ang WRIVE, 1621, VXON, AJAA, Cloud 7, at YGIG. Kalahati ng mapapanalunan ng lucky player ay ido-donate sa Helping Hands Healing Hearts Ministries.

Dahil P-Pop members ang bisita, kantahan at sayawan ay hindi mawawala. Nagpakitang-gilas sina VXON Sam at Franz, at nagbigay ng advice sa mga aspiring P-Pop stars. Pero kung si Jackie Gonzaga ang mag-o-audition, biro ni Meme, hindi papasa dahil P-Pop, as in P-Pangit ang boses ni Jackie. Aray naman, Meme!

Umaray rin si Vice Ganda nang mapag-usapan ang role ni Franz sa grupo. Dahan-dahan lang daw sa pagsabi ng 'MAIN VOCAL.' IYKYK. Baka pwedeng 'mang-aawit' na lang?

Pagkatapos ng fun challenges, si um-arrive ang swerte para kay Ishiro ng grupong WRIVE. Sinubukan ni Kim Chiu na kumbinsihin si Ishiro na tanggapin ang Li-Pot offer. Pero, nag-goodbye siya agad sa P20,000 para sa chance na sagutin ang P100,000 POT question.


Kung first day ng school para sa ibang estudyante, first day rin ng Grand Finals ng Tawag Ng Tanghalan Ika-10 Taon.

Sa unang araw ng bakbakan, sina Crisler Aporbo (Region XIII), Timmy Go (CAR), at Charlie Palalisan (Region XII) ang naglaban-laban,

Swabe ang tama ng performance ni Crisler, na binigyan ng bagong tunog ang classic OPM rock song na "Laklak." Dahil papalapit na sa dulo, itinodo na ni Timmy ang talento at ginawang mas masarap ang tunog ng "Saving All My Love For You." Abot-langit naman ang feels sa mapusong pag-awit ni Charlie ng "In The Stars" by Benson Boone.

Para sa Grand Finals, magkakaroon ng Round 2 ang bawat laban. Muling nagharap ang Top 2 scorers of the day, sina Charlie at Crisler. Sa ikalawang round, parehong naging mapuso ang pag-awit ni Charlie ng "Kung Wala Ka" oroginally by Hale, at ni Crisler, na ginawang ballad ang "Di Ko Na Mapipigilan" ng The Sexbomb Girls.

Parehong nagbigay ng matinding laban pero sa araw na ito, isa lang ang pwedeng umangat sa tanghalan. At ito ay si Charlie, na nakakuha ng score ng 93%.

title: In their P-POP era? ANNE CURTIS, KIM CHIU bumuo ng girl group!
description:
Nabalot ng P-pop feels ang buong studio, at nabalot din ng pag-asa ang puso ng mga typhoon victims na kasali sa Laro Laro Pick, sa ikalawang araw ng 16th anniversary special na unang ipinalabas noong December 2, 2025.

Itinaas agad ni Darren Espanto ang energy sa studio with his version of "Dungka" by P-pop Kings SB19. Walang patid ang excitement as he passed on the spotlight to VXON. Present din DNA, 1621, WRIVE, and G22 to show us what they’ve got. And all the ladies in the studio, kinilig sa performance ng BGYO. Na-surprise naman ang lahat sa debut ng pinakabagong “It’s Showtime” girl group. Isang red hot version ng “Pantropiko” ang regalo nina Kim Chiu, Jackie Gonzaga, Cianne Dominguez at Anne Curtis–the SWT16. Sino ang bias mo? Present din sa studio si BINI member Gwen Apuli para mag-cheer sa buong P-pop community.

It’s the season of giving! Maagang pamasko ang handog ng “It’s Showtime” sa mga typhoon victims mula Isabela, Catanduanes, at Aurora na sumalang sa “Laro Laro Pick.” Ikinuwento nina Joan, Ayen, at Nestor ang naging karanasan sa gitna ng baha at landslide. Halos lahat sila ay nawalan ng tahanan, at may iba namang nawalan ng mahal sa buhay.

Kuwento ng kabayanihan naman ang bitbit ni Tata sa “Laro Laro Pick” arena. Isa ang pamilya niya sa mga nasalanta ng mga nagdaang bagyo. Pero nakakahanga ang kabutihan at tapang ni Tata, na kinalimutan ang sarili at mas inuna ang pagsagip sa isang matandang kapitbahay at mga alagang hayop na nangangailangan ng rescue kaysa isalba ang sariling mga gamit, na kalaunan ay sinira ng baha.

Bukod sa P10,000 na maagang ipinamigay bago magsimula ang games sa “Laro Laro Pick,” umulan pa ng mas maraming papremyo. Ang mga nakarating sa dulo ng laro, nakaipon ng P16,000. Pero ang pinakamalaking swerte ay dumapo kay Banang, ang nakapili ng lucky balloons sa PILImination round.

Sabi ni Banang, kung masaya na siya sa P5,000 ay mas lalo pang malaking tulong ang P300,000 na offer sa Li-Pot. Kaya pinili niya ito kaysa sa P1 million Pot question. Mas bumuhos naman ang luha at saya sa buong studio nang ipamigay ni Vice Ganda ang natitirang P700,000 mula sa P1 million jackpot money. Ang P700,000 ay paghahati-hatian ng remaining players na mga typhoon victims.

title: Miss Q&A BEKLAMATION
description:
Sa isang Sabadong makulay, mga beki na fierce ang nagpamalas ng wit at nagpalaganap ng good vibes sa unang weekly finals ng "Miss Q and A."

Kanya-kanyang paandar sa pagrampa sina Miss Jawo ng Antipolo City, Kelly Agustin ng Nueva Ecija, Elisse Kagandahan Alamo ng Quezon City, Miss Mia ng Malolos Bulacan, Andrea Jane ng Del Monte Quezon City, at Barbie Bratz Ayuda ng Trece Martires Cavite.

Agad uminit ang puksaan ng mga kandidata dahil lahat ay sumabak with full confidence. Sina Barbie Bratz at Miss Jawo, mainit ang dugo sa isa't isa. Kaya biro ni Vice Ganda, kung sino pang magkamukha, sila pa ang nag-aaway!

Mula sa anim na nagpabilisan at nagpatalinuhan sa 'TumPAK Ganern' round, apat lang ang umabante sa 'WIT Lang' kung saan self-expression at pagiging creative sa mga sagot ang naging labanan. Sina Miss Jawo, Barbie, Kelly at Elisse ang pumasok sa second round.

At mula naman sa kanilang apat, sina Miss Jawo ang Kelly ang nag-face-off sa BEKLAMATION kung saan iisang tanong lamang ang kanilang sinagot. Ito ay kung anong makeup product ang ibibigay nila sa kanilang tatay.

Parehong 'lipstick' ang naisip nilang sagot, pero nagkaiba sa lalim ng paliwanag. Mas tumatak kina hurado Alexa Ilacad, Ralph de Leon, at Nicole Cordoves ang talak ni Kelly, kaya siya ang itinanghal na Miss Q and A Reyna TalakERA of the week! Nakakuha si Kelly ng average score na 9.3, samantalang 8 naman ang grado ni Miss Jawo.

Masaya ang selebrasyon para sa mga tatay na puno ng dedikasyon. Minsan seryoso, minsan ay korni ang banat. Pero kahit magkakaiba, pagmamahal at sipag nila ay palaging sapat. Happy Father's Day sa mga madlang tatay!

Saludo tayo sa pagsisikap ni Mel, ang hardworking daddy, na walang sinasayang na oras sa pag-aalaga at pagtatrabaho for his family. Perfect naman for the celebration ang good vibes na dala ng Showtime hosts na sumalang sa bagong paboritong aktingan ng bayan, ang 'You Gotta Lyric' round.

Sina Vice at Vhong Navarro, parang na-enjoy ang 'physical' acting... parang totoo?! Heto ang siguradong totoo, para kay Mel ang araw na 'to! Matapos ma-eliminate ang lahat ng players, pangalan niya ang nabunot para maglaro sa jackpot round.

Dahil minsan lang ang ganitong experience, hindi nagpatinag si Mel na piliin ang POT question. May reward from the universe ang masisipag at matatapang! Dahil sa pagsugal niya sa POT, naiuwi ni Mel ang papremyong P300,000!

title: Miss Q&A Jeraldine & Franco
description:
Inabangan ng sangkabaklaan ang harapan ng mga beki na mahusay sa talakan. Mula Lunes hanggang Biyernes sa “It’s Showtime,” sinala ang mga kandidata sa Miss Q and A Resbakulawan, at sa araw na 'to, Sabado, nagkaalaman na kung sino sa limang weekly finalists ang best.

Chukchak mode on sina Ivern Doroteo, Ringo Antonio, Jeraldine Brittany Hawthorne, Franco Gray, at Billy Labitan Yadao. Bago ang talak, sunod-sunod agad ang patutsada ng mga baklang 'di pakakabog sa isa't isa. At sino itong kandidata na tila ba napagtulungan ng mga kasamahan?

Mula lima, apat ang pumaslak sa Wit Lang round. Mga tanong dito, hindi naman kailangan dibdibin, mas okay kung sasakyan ang 'amats' at lalaruin. At ang Top 2 wittiest candidates of them all, sina Billy at Ringo, umabante sa next round na Beklamation.

Umugong ang swerte sa Laro Laro Pick game arena! Umugong din ang pag-asa para sa players na mula sa Brgy. Ugong, Pasig City. Sino kaya ang makakatawid hanggang jackpot round, at makakapag-uwi ng POT money na P300,000?

Fresh frm breakup pa si Sharmy nang maki-join sa kulitan sa Laro Laro Pick. Naikuwento rin niya kung bakit sila naghiwalay ni ex. At ang dahilan? Girl best friend! Kaya sina Anne Curtis at ibang hosts ay napaisip, red flag ba ang isang taong committed na pero super close at minsan nag-a-"I love you" kay best?

Umabante sa jackpot round ang mapagmahal na asawa at ama na si Kokey. Eh di isama na 'yan sa Team Loyal a.k.a. ang samahan ng mga takot sa asawa!

title: Miss Q&A, naging 'PISIKALAN'?
description:
Over the moon ang saya sa pagbisita ni “Tawag Ng Tanghalan” pride Carmelle Collado, fresh from her recent Eurovision Asia journey. Napili ang kantang in-interpret ni Carmelle, "Sobra-Sobra," bilang entry ng Pilipinas sa unang Eurovision Song Contest Asia.

At siyempre, kumpleto ang September 1 dahil hindi lang basta sumilip kundi live na live ang Chan-ta ng Pinas, Jose Mari Chan. Nagkatotoo ang 'memes' nang personal niyang dalhin ang Christmas feels sa “It’s Showtime.”

Wish upon a star, mga kandidata, wit at confidence nila ay on full display. Sina Ringo Antonio, Gina Ganda, at Franco Gray ang nagpakitang-gilas sa “It’s Showtime” today.

Ang trip nila, sumabak sa sayawan. May bonus performance pa si Franco, na inilabas ang kanyang action-star moves a la Coco. Pero kung hataw na hataw sila sa dance floor, medyo napaisip naman ang ating queens pagdating sa tanungan sa “Tumpak Ganern.”

Ang Wit Lang, naging exciting dahil sa face-off nina Franco at Ringo. Napunta kay Franco ang tanong na, “Bakit pa tinatawag na rush hour kung hindi naman umaandar ang traffic?” Samantala, napaisip si Ringo kung maninigarilyo pa ba ang kapre kahit may hika ito.

Habang binibilang ang mga araw bago dumating ang Christmas bonus, sa "It's Showtime" muna makilaro. Malay mo, may naghihintay na aguinaldo. Swerte kaya ay dumating nang big para sa mga taga-Lower Bicutan, Taguig.

Kilig ang regalo nina Jackie Gonzaga at Darren Espanto. Si Darren, hindi makatingin nang diretso sa ka-eksena, kaya tumawag ng 'take two' si Vice Ganda. Hirit naman ni Kim Chiu, baka hindi makatingin kasi may "feelings" na?!

Ginalingan ni massage therapist Roy sa mga challenges kaya siya ang nakakuha ng spot sa Jackpot Round, kung saan P100,000 ang naghihintay. Para sa anak na nasa autism spectrum, pinili niyang lakasan ang loob at sunggaban ang pagkakataon.

title: Ms. Castro umupo bilang Miss Q&A hurado
description:
Sagot na ni JM Dela Cerna ang pangmalakasang harana. Parang hugis 'otso,' to infinity and beyond ang husay ni JM sa entablado. Pati 'What's up, Madlang People' ibinirit nang todo.

Great ang performance ng tatlong beki na nagtalakan sa Miss Q and A, na sina Ral Imperial ng Batangas, Carla Flores Argonza ng Pangasinan, at Martie Anne Panlilio ng Tarlac.

Hindi 'puchu-puchu' ang tatlong ito, na pare-parehong may napatunayan na sa kanilang pag-aaral. Si Ral ay may dalawang Latin honors, si Carla naman ay may double degree, at si Martie ay scholar.

Na-earn nina Ral at Carla ang respeto ng mga hurado sa talak nilang galing sa puso at pinag-isipan during the Wit Lang round. Nabunot ni Ral ang tanong na, "Sa iyong palagay, saan mas hirap si Rapunzel, mag-blower o mag-shampoo?" Kalmado rin ang pagsagot ni Carla sa tanong na, "Kung huling hininga mo na, anong mas gusto mo, pa-inhale o pa-exhale?"

Markado ang sagot ni Carla kina hurados Ralph de Leon, Nicole Cordoves, at Esnyr na nagbihis bilang Ms. Castro, isa sa mga karakter sa kanyang online series.

Sa Laro Laro Pick, lahat ay swerte, walang malas. Kaya positive vibes lang ang dala ng mga taga-Navotas. Ang laro, nauwi sa concert nang maka-face off ni player Diane si Baby Doll Johaira sa sayawan at kantahan.

Naubos ang players sa It's Giving round kaya bumunot ng dalawang sasabak sa You Gotta Lyric, at ito ay sina Roland at Dindin. Lahat ay lucky pero si Dindin ang may pinakabonggang swerte.

Si Dindin, isang mananahi na solo parent, maingat na pumili. Kung ang kasamang anak ay forda experience ang gusto, si Nanay Dindin, mas gustong maging sigurado at tinanggap ang P40,000 Li-Pot offer.

title: Miss Q&A candidate, hinalikan ni Jhong
description:
Umeksena sa giyera ng mga matatalinghaga sina Nadimunyo Lustre, Adam Lambert, Binibining Heaven Jumawan, Stacey Doroteo, at ang nag-tie na candidates last Friday na sina Nadie Marie Fernandez at Belle Tinkerbell.

Sinala ni Vice Ganda ang kuwento at talento ng mga kandidata, at super na-touch nga siya sa good news ni Heaven na babalik na ito sa eskwela. Pagkatapos huminto nang isang taon dahil sa kakulangang pinansyal, ready to pursue her college education na si Heaven, na na-inspire sa naunang payo ni Meme Vice tungkol sa kahalagahan ng pag-aaral. Nasabi noon ni Vice na gusto niyang mag-aral si Heaven, hindi para sa ibang tao, kundi para sa kan'yang sariling kinabukasan.

Naging mabilis ang pindutan at sagutan sa Tumpak Ganern round, hanggang sa tuluyang nalotlot ang dalawang crowd favorites na sina Nadimunyo Lustre at Belle Tinkerbell. Ang apat na nakasagot naman ay umabante sa Wit Lang para humarap sa playtime questions.

Mula apat, ang Top 2 na sina Nadie at Adam ang nag-face-off sa next round, ang Beklamation, kung saan pareho nilang hinarap ang tanong na, "Sa tingin mo, bakit ka binibigyan ng mga biyayang sa pakiramdam mo ay hindi mo naman deserve?"

Ihiwalay ang de-kolor sa puti, dahil baka ngayong araw ay mas bumango pa ang swerte. Pahinga muna sa paglalaba ang mga laundry shop staff mula Metro Manila para mag-enjoy sa Laro Laro Pick game arena.

Siyempre, hindi kumpleto ang laro kung walang Act-Song! Si Vice Ganda, trip ang eksena ni Jugs Jugueta, at tawang-tawang pina-take two pa niya! Biro naman ni Meme, bet na bet ni Ryan Bang ang eksena niya kasama si Baby Doll Ariel. Hindi rin nakaligtas si Ogie Alcasid sa kulitan nang siya naman ang pagdiskitahan.

Si Jess ang umabot sa Jackpot Round para subukang maiuwi ang ₱450,000 POT. Pero bago ang matinding desisyon, pumili muna si Jess kung sino ang pinakapoging host. Kung si Ogie Alcasid daw ang most ahndsome of them all, nag-unahan naman sina Darren Espanto, Brent Manalo, at Ralph de Leon na kumbinsihin si Jess kung sino sa kanila ang karapat-dapat maging runner-up.

title: Little Q
description: Adapted from the Japanese novel Goodbye, Khoru, following a guide dog and his conflicted master.

title: Department Q: A Conspiracy of Faith
description: Two intertwined cases linking the past with the present require the aid of Department Q to catch an elusive serial killer while time is running out.

title: Miss Q and A
description:
Here to brighten your day, bumisita si Iñigo Pascual para haranahin tayo sa kanta niyang "Ikaw At Ikaw." Ikaw na, Iñigo! Ikaw na ang kakasa sa "Oooh Lala Baby" dance challenge!

Ang mga Miss Q and A ladies, nag-transform from kandidata to comedians real quick! Nagharapan sa talakan sina Iya Zaga Arkanghel ng Laguna, Miss Mia ng Bulacan, at Toni Fowler ng Cavite.

Pinalakpakan ang kanilang galawan at confidence sa rampahan. Ang ‘amats’ nilang tatlo, hindi kayang itago! Pati si Vice Ganda ay naloka sa sagot ng mga kandidata. Kelan pa nging ‘fishda’ ang ingles ng bangus? Nawindang din si Meme sa dilim ng kili-kili ni Toni! Maya-maya pa, sina Iya at Miss Mia ang umabante sa Round 2. Sino ang mas aangat sa talakan?

Salamat sa kanilang sipag, napapanatiling malinis ang ating paligid. Kaya naman deserve nila ang bumida sa 'Laro Laro Pick game arena. Sila ang mga madlang utility workers.

Sa kuwento ni Berto, parang may nag-awoo! Bilang utility worker sa isang ospital, sanay na siya sa mga paramdam, hindi ng ex na nang-ghost, kundi ng mga kakaibang 'nilalang' na paikot-ikot, patakbo-takbo sa ospital na kanyang pinagtatrabahuan.

Kung tumaas ang 'yong balahibo sa kwento ni Berto, tataas naman panigurado ang level of happiness mo sa magulong aktingan sa 'You Gotta Lyric' round. Parang pelikula na kumpleto ang casting, sanib-pwersa sa pag-Act-Song ang paborito nating quadro—Vice Ganda, Anne Curtis, Vhong Navarro at Jhong Hilario.

Ang mommy of walo na si Riz ang umabante sa final stage ng laro. Swerte nga ba ang numerong otso? Nag-goodbye si Nanay Riz sa Li-Pot offer na P35,000, para sugalan ang P25,000 POT question.

description: Televised segments of the CBC Radio One arts show.

title: Dead Mountain Road
description: An idyllic cabin, secluded near a mountain lake, becomes the scene of unspeakable violence as psychotic brothers terrorize a group of campers. When the blood clears, one camper survives -- but her escape is hindered by a devastating car crash, leaving her comatose. When she wakes, her memory is gone, but her desire for revenge is strong and needs satisfying. But it's only when she returns to the scene of the massacre that she ultimately learns the truth from that terrible night.

title: Miss Q&A
description:
Get your Saturday dose of motivation mula kina Vhong Navarro, Jhong Hilario, at Vice Ganda, na nagbahagi ng mensahe as we celebrate World Mental Heath Day.

Paalala ng trio, magpahinga. Sabi nga ni Meme Vice, ang pahinga ay hindi dapat reward lamang matapos mapagod o maubos ang lakas, kundi dapat bahagi ng routine. Hindi kailangang hintaying sagad na sagad na tayo bago huminto at huminga.

Libre lang talaga ang mangarap kaya lakasan ang loob. Sa pamamagitan ng talak na maningning, abutin ang mga bituin. Isang pangmalakasang "Miss Q and " weekly finals ang hatid nina Jeraldine Brittany Hawthorne, JC Ibale, Arci Simon, Jass Lucky, Cola Jane, at Angel Umbac.

Mula sa anim na weekly finalists, apat ang umabante sa Wit Lang round, hanggang ang Top 2 na sina Cola Jane at Arci ang nag-face off sa Beklamation kung saan nasubok ang kanilang paniniwala nang tanungin kung papayag ba sila na may girl best friend ang kanilang boyfriend.

POT money na P100,000 ang goal na masungkit ng mga taga-Caniogan na sumabak sa Laro Laro Pick game arena, with hosts Karylle, Ogie Alcasid, at guest co-host Bianca Umali.

Si player Emo, still waiting for 'the one.' Kaya si Ogie, may payo. Huwag mag-alinlangan na ipagdasal ang taong hinahanap at hinihintay ng puso. Pagpapautang ng biskwit naman ang hanapbuhay ni Glo. Medyo magulo lang mala-slow burn na usapan pero nakarating naman!

Tingnan mo nga naman, sina Emo at Gloria ang natira sa You Gotta Lyric round. Pero hindi nila nahulaan ang pamagat ng mga kanta sa eksena, kaya bumunot ng eliminated player na maglalaro sa jackpot round, at ito ay si Doris.

title: Miss Q&A candidates of the day mga ACADEMIC ACHIEVERS
description:
Sagot na ni JM Dela Cerna ang pangmalakasang harana. Parang hugis 'otso,' to infinity and beyond ang husay ni JM sa entablado. Pati 'What's up, Madlang People' ibinirit nang todo.

Great ang performance ng tatlong beki na nagtalakan sa Miss Q and A, na sina Ral Imperial ng Batangas, Carla Flores Argonza ng Pangasinan, at Martie Anne Panlilio ng Tarlac.

Hindi 'puchu-puchu' ang tatlong ito, na pare-parehong may napatunayan na sa kanilang pag-aaral. Si Ral ay may dalawang Latin honors, si Carla naman ay may double degree, at si Martie ay scholar.

Na-earn nina Ral at Carla ang respeto ng mga hurado sa talak nilang galing sa puso at pinag-isipan during the Wit Lang round. Nabunot ni Ral ang tanong na, "Sa iyong palagay, saan mas hirap si Rapunzel, mag-blower o mag-shampoo?" Kalmado rin ang pagsagot ni Carla sa tanong na, "Kung huling hininga mo na, anong mas gusto mo, pa-inhale o pa-exhale?"

Markado ang sagot ni Carla kina hurados Ralph de Leon, Nicole Cordoves, at Esnyr na nagbihis bilang Ms. Castro, isa sa mga karakter sa kanyang online series.

Sa Laro Laro Pick, lahat ay swerte, walang malas. Kaya positive vibes lang ang dala ng mga taga-Navotas. Ang laro, nauwi sa concert nang maka-face off ni player Diane si Baby Doll Johaira sa sayawan at kantahan.

Naubos ang players sa It's Giving round kaya bumunot ng dalawang sasabak sa You Gotta Lyric, at ito ay sina Roland at Dindin. Lahat ay lucky pero si Dindin ang may pinakabonggang swerte.

Si Dindin, isang mananahi na solo parent, maingat na pumili. Kung ang kasamang anak ay forda experience ang gusto, si Nanay Dindin, mas gustong maging sigurado at tinanggap ang P40,000 Li-Pot offer.

title: Miss Q&A Kishan, nag-sample ng burlesque dancing
description:
Kasama natin for today's video ang bandang The Red Strings, na very inspired sa paggawa ng nakaka-good vibes na musika. Sa mga taong naghahanap ng organic encounter, at para sa lahat, ang kanta nilang "Nasa Ulap."

Matatapos na ang June, pero hindi ang wit at tawanan sa "Miss Q and A." Sina Kishan Garcia ng Makati, Rhain Bayonon ng Manila, at Havana Alawi ng Quezon City ang nagPAKsiklabn sa 'chukchakan' today.

Para kay Kishan, her tattoos are part of her charm at kagandahan. Eh, kung may bagay na tattoo kay Havana, ano kaya ito? May naisip na si Vice Ganda! Pwedeng kulayan daw ng blue si Havana tapos ‘avatar’ ang kalalabasan. 'Amats' nga ni Meme ang beki na may kakaibang 'hugis' ang tainga, at ang boses ay tunog galing ibang planeta. Biro ni Meme, parang nagtatawag ng alien si Havana.

With grace and substance ang talakan nina Kishan at Rhaine sa Wit Lang. Si Kishan, nabunot ang tanong na, "Ilang oras ang dapat itulog ng jowa mong napagod na sayo?" Sagot niya, hindi dapat makatulog sa kaiisip sa kan'ya ang ex-jowa.

Mga kwentong nakakatuwa at may hati na inspirasyon at pag-asa ang pasalubong ng mga taga-Malanday, Marikina sa Laro Laro Pick game arena. Nakakuwentuhan nina Vice Ganda, Kim Chiu at Amy Perez ang isang tricycle driver, na pakiramdam ay wala ng pag-asa ang mga pangarap niya. Kaya ang payo nila, maniwala! Sabi nga ni Kim, "The world is big and so are your dreams."

Big naman ang aktingan sa inaabangan na 'You Gotta Lyric' round. Si Teddy Corpuz, tiklop sa mga lalaking malaki ang katawan. Si Jackie Gonzaga, tiklop naman sa paalala ni Ion Perez na taken na siya.

It must be the curly hair na naghatid ng swerte kay Bert, na sinugalan ang P100,000 POT money. Ano nga ba ang halamang pinakamabilis tumubo ayon sa Guinness World Records?
